Some puzzles require figuring out the correct order of Hiragana. And others require the player to figure out the pronunciation of a Hiragana by looking at what connects with what.

title: Helm Realm
description: Helm Realm is a local and online multiplayer party brawler. The game features a broad variety of weaponry that ranges from a bow and arrow to a spellbook that allows you to cast lightning!

title: Ortolan
description: Dodge & Slash & Bang by a Cute Little Girl.

title: Drill Man Rumble
description: Drill Man Rumble is a Drill-tastic party game that pits drill wielding warriors in a battle for supremacy! Master a wide variety of drills and compete across danger filled arenas but never forget, one hit and you’re DONE!

title: Iceroyds!
description: Iceroyds! is the ultimate family-friendly local multiplayer arcade competition game, for all ages.

title: Tides of Existence
description: Tides of Existence is an action game in medieval setup. The player can use weapons, skills, dragons, and warships to defeat enemies and all kinds of creatures. As the player proceeds through the story, new challenges have to be handled and many mysteries have to be illuminated.

title: Rolling Sky 2
description: Do you remember that the Parkour's pleasure and excitement through simple fingertips swipes in Rolling Sky? The sequel "Rolling Sky 2" will bring you more visual and auditory feasts. Enter a impressive dream journey in the thrilling musical rhythm challenge.

title: Space Tower
description: Choose different weapon combinations, defeat different enemies on the way, and use different combat methods to clear the game.

title: Golf Around!
description: Golf Around! is a multiplayer Mini Golf game with crazy golf courses. In addition, you can easily play and create custom levels!

title: Tale of Starship
description: Tale of Starship is a classic shoot them up, the objective of this game is to survive. Tale of Starship use RNG to generate enemy's wave. Moreover as the game progress, you can upgrade your starship through different ameliorations, each pool of ameliorations is generate randomly.

title: Sumerians
description: Sumerians is a city building game set in ancient Mesopotamia. Attract new citizens and grow by expanding your irrigation system, building walls, temples and ziggurats. Manage your production, hire workers, and trade.

title: Fireworks Mania
description: FIREWORKS MANIA is an small casual explosive simulator game where you can play around with fireworks, create beautiful firework shows or maybe just blow stuff up.

title: Contract Work
description: Contract Work is a 2d sneak & shoot roguelike in a cyberpunk universe. Break into corporate monoliths, evade security, then steal and destroy corporate assets to equip your hi-tech mercenary freelancer!

title: Reanimation Inc.
description: Reanimation inc is a completely realistic simulation - real urgent conditions and diseases, real protocols of care used in an ambulance, realistic simulation of the body! Do you like realistic games about medicine and simulators, games you need to think about? You 'll be happy!

title: Light Hunters: Battalion of Darkness
description: Light Hunters Duel is an online card game, form your battalion of 3 heroes of different classes, and fight until decimate all heroes of your opponents! Each hero has 5 skills that you can activate to reduce the health of enemy heroes.

title: Pakicetus
description: Pakicetus is a deep-sea rogue-lite exploration game. As captain of the Salvation, you must balance resource collection, system upgrades, and a dwindling food supply as you battle against an unknown enemy bent on stopping your search for a new home.

title: Black Bekker
description:
In another world - at a time that seems to have stopped in the late '80s: 
 
The power hungry dictator ADDI ENGLER simply forbids anything that's any fun, and with the help of his vicious robot army he has enslaved almost all fun-loving Metalheads throughout the universe. 
But he did not expect you - you are BLACK BEKKER! 
As a black-clad headbanger, it's up to you to fight your way through Engler's heavily guarded fortress and end his sinister regime once and for all! 
 
Use the METAL as a weapon and shoot at your opponents with killer rivets or beer salvos ... or spray them with an extremely stinking deodorant! Make your way through well over 20 levels full of secret hiding places, crazy items or weird creatures, whipping up your highscore. 
 
But do not forget: you are the last hope for Metal here!

title: Banter Schooldays!!
description: Banter Schooldays!! is a visual novel legal drama adventure game developed by the independent team Lingtan Studio.

title: There is No GreenDam
description: 只是想找一份简单的工作，却没想到惹出这么多麻烦，最终我收到了一个谜一样的测试物——一位少女。那么要从此开启幸福的同居生活了？……不存在的，这仅仅只是大灾变前的预兆！！我与她的故事才刚刚开启……一个临时建成的制作组产出的治愈向Galgame，希望能给你带来小小的感动。

description: Make earthquakes. Turn night into day. Transform into a small furry creature. No one can party like a druid. An adventure game with sarcastic British humor and classic, hand-drawn art.

description:
Get ready to fight your way through an alien abduction nightmare in this retro arena shooter!
You play as a middle-aged farmer who wakes up to find that you have been abducted by aliens. Wearing only a hospital gown and a pair of boxers you manage to get a hold of one of the alien weapons. Can you last long enough for rescue to arrive while taking out as many enemies as you can building combos for an insane high score? Get Me Outta Here is a title action fans and retro enthusiasts will love!

Completely rebuilt remastered version with improved visuals and 2 new ships to fight your way through!

title: Craft Elements
description: Craft Elements is a first person minecraft-esque journey into the nuclear reactor design, periodic table and vaporwave world. It is a unique, simple and atmospheric sandbox puzzle game with a focus on complex simulation and calculations.

title: Stream Fighters
description: The BOYZ club - a place where the most terrible beasts rest. How long will you last in the ring with the most toxic man on the planet? Can you defeat the most patient streamer? However, you just never escape from the clutches of the money-eating spider.

title: Shape Cascade
description: Falling shapes drop from above, can you push them into the right place? Test your skills and fast reflexes in Shape Cascade! Is it better to leave one shape to catch the wondrous bonus star? Or maybe you'd like to squash that annoying laughman... It's up to YOU!

title: Curse of the Dungeon
description: You have to explore amazing places to get to the secret secrets of your soul.

description: You are a simple toy robot with no name, no memory and no serial number. You discover that your battery is damaged. Now the journey to repair your battery and save your life begins... In this journey you will need to: Run, Jump, Shoot and Solve Puzzles.

description: Find yourself diving into a retro-futuristic city infested with bad guys!

description: Project Starship X is a procedural shooter where you Crash-Kill cosmical abominations with your spaceship while playing as Swagthulhu! Whaaat?!??!

description: A simple, fast-paced Game with 105 Unique Battles and Free Redistribution of Stats. Outmaneuver Enemies to get Flames, quickly switch between Skills to win Battles and defeat Bosses to gain new Skills.

title: World of Conquerors: Origins
description: Grow your empire and dominate the world, either through diplomacy or destruction. Forge alliances or go it alone, play as loyal men, elegant elves or brutish orcs.

title: Industriworks
description: Dig and build in a blocky sandbox world, economize heat in smelter to smelt more resources at once. There is few ores, metals, alloys and other materials, that you can use in your crafting to make powerful tools and golems.

description: Save the mysterious land of monsters, finding the solution of the disorder 2D exploring action game, that can play with two player too. Defeat powerful enemies, and explore everywhere.

description: Pocket Cars is a fast paced arcade combat-racing game, where you can drive RC cars that speed through amazing tracks. From real-life obstacles to outstanding off-road abilities, maneuverability and boost capacity of the realistic looking vehicles, an amazing racing experience await for you.

description: Build your own airships by snaping engines, envelops, fins and gondolas together. Then fly it freely or watch it blow up in the sandbox!

title: DepowerBall
description:
DepowerBall is a competitive party platformer where the fate of every matchup is influenced by fast-paced athletic gameplay and tactical decision-making.

Whether it’s feeding the hungry Dragon Queen or playing keep-away with a golden treat, every match, each player starts with the same set of powers to try and accomplish their task of becoming the Royal Champion! When a player wins a round, he or she will earn the Queen’s favor, but will also earn the wrath of the other players, who are then able to vote to take away one of the winner’s powers! Get ready to even the odds against your opponents as you take away the powers they hold most dear and hilariously watch how they deal with the consequences! Whoever is the first person to win three rounds, becomes the Royal Champion!
In the world of DepowerBall, you will need to adapt to the changing conditions, or get left behind as the other players take advantage of your weakened state!

title: Money Loves Silence
description: In the game Money Loves Silence, you’re a bank employee and it’s your job to go after debtors. Everyone’s past catches up with them at some point and you’re no exception. You’ll need to help yourself when this happens. Buy everything you need and get ready to head out on an adventure.

title: Forbidden Love With the Ghost Girl
The Final Earth 2
description: The Final Earth 2 is a vertical city builder in space. Earth is unlivable, so you decide to create a space colony. Gather resources, then build and research your way to a better future! Grow your city from an exploration ship to a huge metropolis, full of advanced technology. What will you build?

title: Squillamorph
description: Squillamorph is a challenging action-platformer set in a mysterious mechanical world. Pursued by hordes of brutal enemies, you must use your parasitic ability to 'infest' and take control of them. Fight back, survive, and you might just discover your purpose.

description: A new era of physics based platforming is about to begin. Play as fusion powered killer android Lazr, facing off against rogue AI and mega-corporations in Alpha City One.

title: Phantom Path
description: Explore the ruins of a lost ancient city, uncover the mystery of its esoteric technology, and claim its incredible treasure as your own.

title: Npc Problems: Vertex Coloring
description: In the world, there are some problems that cannot be solved by today's computers. Being necessary the use of artificial intelligence to get a good and fast solution. In the Npc Problems series, these problems are posed for you to solve. Can you overcome this challenge?

description: In this game, you will play as Stefan Pierce, a teenager who suffers memory loss which makes him remember nothing but his name. Now let's find out what is exactly happen to you!

title: Halloween Chronicles: Evil Behind a Mask - Collector's Edition
description: A trio of masks could bring about an era of nightmares!

title: Mr. Pumpkin 2: Kowloon Walled City

title: Hidden World of Art 2
description: In the hidden object game "Hidden World of Art 2" you have to restore real classical paintings by finding hidden items and solving puzzles!

title: Space electrician
description: Space electrician is a classic falcon in a space setting

title: Carnival Hunt
description: Carnival Hunt is an asymmetric multiplayer horror game set inside a living, ever-shifting mechanical carnival designed by the Puppetmaster. One player becomes the Carnival Monster, while others play as puppet Bunnies struggling to survive, ascend, and escape the hunt.

title: Jetboard Joust
description:
Classic arcade-style SHMUP meets hardcore modern roguelike! Take flight on a lethal, pimped-up jetboard, darting through the skies and blasting alien invaders with an explosive arsenal of extreme weaponry. Face off against massive, multi-stage bosses as you protect innocent civilians from being abducted and turned into mutants. An arcade classic for the next generation!

Jetboard Joust blends the spirit and intensity of 1980s arcade coin-op SMHUPs with the replayability and tactical elements of hardcore modern roguelikes. Don't expect a story. Do expect frantic, fluid, fast-paced 60fps action, big guns, and explosions!

The Jetboard: Leap from your jetboard like a boss to gain temporary invincibility and smash your enemies to smithereens. Destroy pretty much everything in your path. You rock.

The Enemies: Over fifty different enemies to outwit. Be prepared for them to come at you with all the game's weapons plus their own special attacks. Watch out for a few tributes to classic arcade games of the past too...

The Weapons: From the conventional to the ridiculous! Jetboard Joust offers over thirty powerful weapons, each with its own distinct advantages and upgrade path, to aid you on your mission and leave a path of total destruction in your wake. Get up close and dish out massive damage with the shotgun, wreak havoc with the cluster bomb, fry enemies to a crisp with the flame tornado or shock them into submission with the lightning bolt. You'll get a different selection of weapons with each playthrough and you'll need to master them all!

The Bosses: Defeat huge bosses in a series of grueling multi-stage battles and then steal their attacks for your own use. Rendered in exquisite pixel-art detail, these guys will test your weapon-handling and evasive maneuvering to their limits.

The Planets: Choose your own path through a multitude of battlegrounds across the surface of five different planets. Discover hidden treasure, upgrades and awesome new weapons. Adapt your route based on your playstyle, the weapons you unlock and the treasure you discover. Plunder cash from fallen enemies and use it to pimp up your jetboard, jetsuit and max out your weapons for a formidable arsenal. Are you up to the challenge?

title: Labirint
description: Imagine a labyrinth where walls move every time the player moves making it impossible to calculate your way to the goal in advance so you'll have to improvise.

title: Haunted Hotel: Room 18 - Collector's Edition
description: A family reunion at the Sweet 18 hotel turns into a night of terror!

title: Ved
description: Ved is a story-driven, hand-drawn RPG with a unique turn-based combat system and roguelite elements. Set in two different worlds, VED tells the story of Cyrus, a young hero who sets out on a quest to become a master of sword and magic, and save everything he knows from destruction.

title: Listeria Wars
description: Listeria Wars is a tactical strategy where we protect the hero’s body from various infections and viruses by controlling the troops of the immune system. We can observe his personal life and even influence it with side effects.

title: Kamodo Steve! Janitor on Fire!
description: Kamodo Steve is an 2.5D action sidescroller where you play as Steve, an unwilling hero with unrealized power. Steve and his friend Shiloh team up to disrupt the sinister plans of the Robber Barons, a kabal of industrialists whose only motivations are success, power and greed.

title: 3 Blind Mice: A Remediation Game For Improper Children
description: A remediation game designed for last attempt corrections for particularly troubled youth. Failure to complete this game may result in removal from society. Please do not attempt to find the surveillance units. They are only present for monitoring your progress. Have a pleasant day.

title: Heavens Tournament
description: If you love anime, fighting and Virtual Reality or looking for a fun workout, then this is the game for you!

title: Through the Unknown
description: Through The Unknown is a 3D platformer where you try to survive deadly environments as a little jelly cube. Play through a courageous story mode and unlock new features for the level editor, where you can create your own courses to play.

title: Relivium
description: Relivium is a survival horror game set in a mysterious military archipelago plagued with soldiers infected by a once dormant aquatic parasite, and a haunting, mysterious presence... Set after the events of WW2, explore, manage your resources, and survive.

title: You are Pig Sitter
description: You need to plow the soil and grow up crops with poor land for live. make machine with doctor and use it ! you can make more efficient way to harvest! and one day make automatic everything!

title: Imperiums: Greek Wars
description: Imperiums: Greek Wars is a unique combination of turn-based 4X and historical grand strategy with a mythological twist. Explore the ancient world and open it up to your people. Survive, expand, conquer... and win!

title: Bonsai Castles
description: A tower defense game based on Japanese castles. Excavate the ground to create a moat, build walls and turrets, and fight off the enemies that attack you!

title: A Pirate's Pleasure
description: Sail the Caribbean Sea in this epic tale of true love, treasure, and intrigue. How will you navigate the changing tides? Only you can decide.

title: Hide and Secret: The Lost World
description: Travel deep into the mysterious jungle of the Lost World! The nefarious treasure thief Jacques kidnapped damsel, and it’s up to you to stop his evil plans before she is sacrificed at the spooky full moon ritual.

title: Sanpo Suru Keyboard-tsukai
description: Yes, you will be "Typing Hero".

title: Escape from the Lostmoon
description: Cosmic pilot has lost his ship on the remote asteroid populated by disaster human colony, where outbreak of the unknown virus took place. Hungry zombies, villainous mercenaries and monsters are everywhere. Only you ... and his awesome arsenal could lead hero to freedom.

title: My Lucky Koi
description: Its`A humorous Daily story——A friendship story between a hard worker and a Koi leprechaun.——This is a Chinese short visual novel with single ending.

title: Magic of Autumn
description: Magic of Autumn is a singleplayer card game with an overworld - and everything in the overworld can be turned into cards.

title: Astro Puppa
description: Destroy all asteroids and your self esteem! Prove that you are not a Noob reaching the perfect score of 8888! 8===> A tough game for tough gamers!

title: Last Neighbor
description: You play as a young thief who broke into the wrong house, he thought the place was empty because he saw the owners leaving with suitcases, but there was still somebody in the house. It could be dangerous so you have to get out fast.

title: FIT Food
description: FIT Food is a multiplayer card game. Have fun playing and learning about food at the same time. How do food items compare on healthiness, cost, and environmental impact? You probably know more than you think - but there will be surprises to you as well.

title: Cosmo story
description: Help the hero stop the invasion of enemy invaders, and save the universe from destruction.

title: Warchasm
description: Battle hordes of murderous mechs as you hurtle through the canyons, chasms and caves of an alien world in a desperate bid for survival.

title: Whispered Secrets: Dreadful Beauty - Collector's Edition
description: Can you save your friend and escape from Acorn Hospital in time?

title: KuniTure
description: A game that looks pretty, but not easy

title: Blades of Gory
description: Blades of Gory is an easy to learn, hard to master, ultraviolent, 8 bit styled 2D fighting game. 8 warriors to choose from. 4 game modes. Arcade, versus, sudden death and 3 vs 3 tag team battle.

title: Cahertis
description:
Build your reputation with the people of Athara, maintain your gear, enchant it, and recruit companions to fight alongside you. Refine your talents in various masteries (fishing, lock picking, herbalism, pickpocketing…) and develop your combat skills in a turn-based strategy game called Cahertis.

In a medieval fantasy universe, play as Frey, a young recruit in a corrupt guard and investigate Antus. Recruit companions, rise in rank in the guard, and unravel the mysteries of Athara.

title: Choose for ME
description: Dive yourself in the Choose for ME universe and enter the reality of Mads Ever, a forgetful developer who will have to make his way through singular puzzles and some strange event due to his past...

title: Forest Ranger Simulator
description: Forests are flooded with rubbish! Let’s have a look at the valley you live in - entirely covered with them… It’s a high time you finally hunker down, grab a bin liner and lets your area challenge you - explore it and admire how the view is changing when you take care of it.

title: White Wings
description: "White Wings" uses the Japanese "e-mote" animation system. This is an agonizing wintertime love song. Broken families, Experiences of bullying, Tears concealed by smiles. Young men and women, three encounters, each carries sorrowful secrets in the cold winter. Embracing each other and absorbing the earth’s final, small bit of warmth.

title: CubeParkour
description: A simple parkour-platformer to have some fun and pass time. You are a cube and you have to get from point A to point B as creatively as possible. That's it. There are 100 levels at the moment.

title: Takkyu Tournament Re:Serve
description: This fantasy kung fu ping-pong mashup pays homage to classic retro arcade games while incorporating fighting game trappings like blocking, parrying, unique fighters, and special moves.

title: Stickman go
description: “Stickman go” is a puzzle game based on physics engine. In this game, player need to move stickman out of screen based on real physical phenomena. Sway, sway, sway. Don't stuck!

title: Klock
description: A fantasy adventure story featuring card battles (Trading Card Game in digital edition, only supporting Chinese now).

title: Myriad Tower Defense
description: Myriad TD is a tower defense strategy game. You build towers on a map of hexagons that will attack and defeat oncoming waves of enemies. Towers can be upgraded and some have varied upgrade paths. The goal is clear as many waves as possible. How far can you get?

title: Mega Balls
description: Mega Balls is a game of precision and persistence as you attempt to save your pal Good Boi! Navigate your ball through levels with unique layouts and obstacles all while being pulled down by the force of gravity.

title: Unnamed Adventure
description: Unnamed Adventure, an indie action platformer where every single level, puzzle is crafted by hands. Wander around in a mysterious kingdom where surprise and finding may hide in every corner you visit.

title: Death Park
description: Can you solve all the puzzles and escape from the scary clown in this horror game? It is already waiting for you!

title: The Adventures of Willow and Ash
description: The Adventures of Willow and ash is a platform adventure game, with a classic style and feel. You play as Willow, a young mage looking for your love ash who was taken from her. You will have to traverse obstetrical and slay monsters as you make your way through the world.

title: All Day Dying
description: A SINGLEPLAYER score attack game for quick sessions of focused adrenaline where you complete various goals without any story to get in the way.

title: Catch the Ball 3
description: Catch the ball 3 is an awesome skillful brainteaser game. The game is originally the sequel of two popular web games Catch the ball 1 and 2. All you have to do is put the ball into the cup. Sounds easy, isn't? The way you do it is by creating lines that get the ball into the cup.

title: Kyle is Famous
description: Kyle tries to prepare for his most important interview yet. Choose his path through 21 endings and accept the consequences in this comedic adventure.

title: Robot Boy
description: Hi my name is RX-4, I am a robot, I can not control my body alone, try to help me go home please. Hmmmm ... I'm not going to hide it, I have no hope in you and I do not think you'll succeed. Already many people have tried to help me and have failed.

title: The Cruxis Sword
description: An extra-terrestrial parasite has infected the planet and is causing its energy to become polluted. Follow our heroes as they partake on a journey to rid the planet of the darkness before its too late.

title: Fateless
description: FPS game in which you defend Earth from monsters. You shoot the monsters with a double-barrel shotgun and other weapons and move through various buildings made of brick and stone. You make your way to the underground where the monsters came from and rid the planet of their presence.

title: Pumpkin Jack
description: Pumpkin Jack is a Spooky Scary 3D platformer in which you embody Jack, the Mythical Pumpkin Lord! Dive into an Epic Adventure through otherworldly landscapes and help the Evil annihilate the Good!

title: Cats are Liquid: A Better Place
description: Cats are Liquid: A Better Place is a 2D platformer about a liquid cat and her friends. Over the course of the game, you get to explore 120 rooms and discover new abilities like the hookshot and light burst. You can also create your own worlds, and share them with others through the Steam Workshop.

title: Phoenix Tales
description: A hybrid adventure/RPG Something strange is happening in the land of Rydanthia. You arrive in the town of Northern Cross and quickly discover things are not what they seem. Can you solve the mysteries surrounding this threat? Can you live to tell the tale?

title: Incredible Dracula: Witches' Curse
description: Dracula has his undead hands full in this all-new adventure that pits him against a truculent trio of aging witches who will stop at nothing to restore their youth. Has Dracula met his match or can he save the day? The fate of all magic is in your hands!

title: Pulstario
description: A small, challenging space game about collecting missing souls in the void.

title: InfiniteBeat
description: INFINITE BEAT is an entertaining game where you have the opportunity to test your reflexes by smashing Neon Beats with Laser Discs, which will magnetically return to your hands after firing. By using special abilities, the game gets more dynamic and you can earn much more points.

title: Displace
description: Single player, first-person puzzle game where you can spawn cubes and spheres while utilising switches, launch pads and boost pads to navigate through deceiving blocks to the next teleporter

title: Ether Loop
description: Ether Loop is a hardcore fast-paced bullet hell with roguelike elements. Descend the unforgiving depths of a mysterious world, encounter challenges, discover dynamic environments and fight ruthless creatures while unveiling the secrets of Ether Loop.

title: Thunder's Leaves
description: Thunder's Leaves is a modification about Combine technologies and their usage by rebels.

title: Glowcoma: Chapter 1
description: Glowcoma: Chapter 1 is a Sci-Fi FPS survivor horror game.

title: Creature Card Idle
description: Idler meets TCG! An incremental game where you place cards strategically on a grid to generate resources, and you spend those resources to purchase booster packs containing new cards.

title: Coffee Rush
description: Race through the office in this chaotic coffee-fueled satire. Find printer paper, dodge chatty coworkers, avoid spills, and grab abandoned coffee cups to boost your speed. Deliver enough to meet the boss or keep going to hit the leaderboard — but hurry, or you're fired!

title: Classic Sudoku
description: Classic Sudoku is a sudoku puzzle game. The sudokus in the game cover a wide range of difficulty with something for everyone - and also require an incredible range of techniques to solve them efficiently! Players start with zero stars and earn stars by solving puzzles. The more puzzles you solve, the more stars you earn and the more puzzles you get to play.

title: Warrior Spirit
description: A 3D adventure video game for all ages. Use Warrior Spirit's many tools and abilities such as the Four Arms, Bracelets of Good, and Clay for platforming, combat, exploring, and solving puzzles. Travel through various lands and defeat Evil by serving the will and power of Perfect Good.

title: Bloodholic
description: The vampire who died was given the right to seek truth because of rebirth. As the identity changed, she changed from a victim to a criminal suspect... How can this be self-certified?

title: Cyberpunk Bar Sim
description:
This Cyberpunk-styled game is inspired by the gameplay of Game Dev Tycoon and the aesthetic of VA-11 HALL-A, sci-fi, and lo-fi city beats!

Own and manage a futuristic bar, meet quirky customers, market, and expand!

title: Chrono Ark
description: Chrono Ark is a party-based deck-building roguelike single player RPG game about rescuing the world from chaos. Recruit, train, and build a team of unique investigators throughout the abandoned land and restore the Twisted World!

title: Airhack
description: You are a secret Agent who begins work for the Airem as Hacker. Hacking servers of global corporations for profit, stealing data, manipulate the stock market, modify peoples academic or criminal records, laundering money, erasing evidence, framing innocent people. Do not trust anyone.

title: The Emerald Tablet
description: Enter the world of alchemy in the daily adventures of the money-hungry but good intentioned Misty, the arrogant adventure-seeking Gladys, and the explosive "expert" Winifred.

title: Neighbourhood Loot
description: THIEVES...Everywhere...But it's enough, No More, Time to take back YOUR Neighbourhood! Fight Back with all you have in this comedic, cartoonish themed strategic tower defence, created to give you hours of replayability and ridiculous mayhem. WELCOME to NEIGHBOURHOOD LOOT Good Citizen!

title: Dungeon Dreams (Female Protagonist)
description: Roguelike Romance JRPG with a female protagonist. Customize your characters, take open-ended quests and write your own story in the town of Ecallia. A game with town building, dating and life sim elements, but also a randomly generated Dungeon with lots of companions and loot!

title: Jian Wei Jun Wu
description: Love story with samurais living in Japan This is a splendid Japanese adventure game which its story is happened in "The Land of the Rising Sun" where human, Yōkai and Oni were living together.

title: Loga: Unexpected Adventure
description: A Classic fun beautiful platform game that is made to challenge you with more than 30 levels.

title: Exophobia
description: Explore and fight your way through a crashed human spaceship infested with relentless hordes of aliens as you become more powerful with exciting weapon upgrades and powerups in this retro inspired first-person shooter.

title: Door in the Woods
description: This game is a venture into an alternative timeline in which graphics and sensible game design were never invented.

title: Oil Mogul
description: Experience the oil intoxication and become a successful oil entrepreneur in the 19th century in North America. Manage price fluctuations and sell oil or kerosene. While you earn money by digging up and selling oil, the city will grow with you.

title: Castle Commander
description: Pick attackers up and toss them into the air, moments later a satisfying squish as they hit the ground. Defend your castle from hoards of attacks. Upgrade your castle, land, and research with new defences & technology.

title: PLAYNE VR
description: Improve mental well-being, build resilience to stress, get calm and experience lasting relaxation. Playne is an immersive VR experience that teaches you meditation and helps you to build a daily habit of meditation. Playne is a game that grows with you.

title: Tales of Tomorrow: Experiment
description: ToT: Experiment is a sci-fi short story game set on a remote ship wandering through space. Without any memories or recollection of his past our hero is tasked by the ship AI - EVE to perform daily tasks, that will help to maintain the ship.

title: The Walker
description: The Walker is an adventure game made by chinese developers Heymaker and Renyi Tech. LLC.

title: Miss Right?
description: This is A story about Miss Right. "TIangou" is a Chinese internet word. Means A man, who love a Girl, Give everything to the Gril,but GIrl do not accept him. Just like Miss Right, but your Miss right do not think you are Mr Right.

title: Phantom Hills
description: As the Paranormal Detective, Hudson Black, you explore an isolated town, trying to uncover the dark secrets of anomalies. Will you survive? Will you help, join or destroy the unknown forces? It is up to you, Detective.

title: Arzt Simulator
description: Arzt Simulator - Nimm die Rolle eines Arztes ein und behandle erfolgreich Deine Patienten. Messe den Blutdruck, horche die Lunge ab, fertige Röntgenbilder an und vieles mehr. Stelle die richtige Diagnose und heile Deine Patienten mit der richtigen Therapie!

title: Crazy City
description: This is a first person shooter game,The player is in a city full of enemies.Players are free to explore the surrounding area, Health must be guaranteed by evading or killing enemies,Players can use their own weapons or rob enemy weapons.

title: Epic Fun
description: Epic Fun is a collection of theme park-inspired attractions. You'll find a roller coasters with an exclusive rail shooting game, a free fall tower and a Hammer It game entirely for free.

title: After Gloom
description: A man enters the enigmatic Common Dream in search of a woman he once loved.

title: In the Service of Mrs. Claus
description: You’re the only elf who can save Christmas from the forces of darkness! Clash with cults, gods, and giant corporations to preserve Mrs. Claus's empire.

title: Inferna
description: Inferna is a player-friendly, free-to-play open-world MMORPG with unique combat system and a game world that sets no limits to the game experience.

title: A Long Stroll
description: The game that an old woman walks in a long straight road.

title: Gang District
description: Gang District is a local multiplayer shooter party game with a share screen mechanism. Pick up a weapon and start blasting and kick some tail!

title: VenusBlood Frontier International
description: Loki Muspelheim, an exiled member of demon nobility strives for the throne of the Dark Lord who has wronged him. To succeed the throne and exact his revenge, he must obtain the hidden treasure on the Floating Continent of Yggdrasil, protected by the goddesses of the seasons and their Chief God Odin.

title: Drawkanoid: Review Breaker
description: Smash through Steam reviews at hyperspeed, then guess which game they came from. Key resellers are bad for the industry, support developers directly!

title: Robin Hood: Country Heroes
description: Master archer Robin is at your disposal as you take on the Sheriff of Nottingham and his lackeys! You'll need a quick hand and an even quicker mind, but the reward of helping the downtrodden will make your mission worth every challenging step!

title: New York Mysteries: The Outbreak
description: “New York Mysteries: The Outbreak” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects with unforgettable characters and challenging quests to conquer, plenty of mini-games and puzzles!

title: Volleyball Fever Flat
description: Stick your feet in the sand and play beach volleyball on a tropical island. Volleyball Fever Flat is a sports game where you play 2v2 volleyball matches against computer-controlled opponents.

title: Scriptum VR: The Neighbor's House Escape Room
description: The Neighbor's House is the latest game of the Scriptum saga. Play this Virtual Reality Escape room and feel the tension around every corner. Will you be able to get out on time?

title: The Adventures of Looppy
description: Immerse yourself in the magical world of adventure and puzzles with Looppy!

title: Hero Soul: I Want to be a Hero!
description: Learn what it means to be a hero in this classically inspired JRPG! Help Cecilia Grey follow in her father's footsteps to become a respected adventurer.

title: Legend of the 9 Swords: Side Story
description: Legend of the 9 Swords: Side Story is a 2-Dimensional illustrated narrative role-playing game that is hand animated to give every hero and enemy there own style and feel.

title: Defend Them !
description: Defend Them ! is a fictionally ironic tower defense game about killing enemies and defending human infrastructure.

title: Royal Detective: The Last Charm - Collector's Edition
description: Can you rescue your daughter and save both realms in time?

title: TriangleStorm
description: TriangleStorm is a simple and challenging side-scroller game where you change the gravity on command and avoid the storm of triangles.

title: Private Investigator Simulator
description: Assume the role of a modern detective and solve fascinating cases using lots of gadgets and your own skills. Let a sophisticated narrative help you uncover clues and secrets that might not be apparent right away and become a star detective.

title: Psihanul
description: PSIHANUL- you will take revenge on the bosses and colleagues for the fact that you were fired, shoot and break everything around you, do not leave anything behind you, destroy this office and no one will help you in this, so good luck and don't freak out.

title: The Delirium Vacation
description: The Delirium Vacation is a surreal first person puzzle game from Ex Conspectu. Delve deep into the expanse of your own mind and experience the internal war between your inner Demons and your inner...hedgehogs.

title: Death to the Dragon Lord
description: For over a millennia the land of Aforn has been under the tyrannical rule of the Dragon Lord. All attempts to overthrow him have led to near genocide, but the Dragon Lord's cruelty is so great that despite the consequences another revolt is brewing.

title: Puzzle Patrol
description: Puzzle Patrol is a unique and modern spin on the falling blocks arcade puzzler, inspired by classics like Tetris, Puyo Puyo, and Puzzle League.

title: Pixels can fight
description: Pixels can fight is an adventure of 4 friends in a physics-based pixel world. Fight each other in arenas.

title: Project Apocalypse
description: Build a post-apocalyptic city and protect it from the infected. Survive.

title: Output Pasture
description: Output Pasture is a fast-paced Tower Defense Game which combines the elements of roguelike. Unlock, combine unique animals to battle together, and fight the evil Machine Legion.

title: Ghouls Underground
description: A gigantic Shoot-em-up/metroidvania.

title: Occultus Command
description: It is the year 3260, a cosmic storm named Father's Wrath threatens to end life on Earth's upper layer. The surest way to survive Father's Wrath is to escape underground to a world called Occultus. Information on the incoming storm and Occultus is encrypted, hidden and monitored.

title: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant
description: Trade, traverse, and earn coins in this strategy merchant game set in a handcrafted world shaped by secrets and volatile markets. Join Viia, the fox merchant, as she defies the mighty Basilisk Company in the hunt for the truth behind the Golden Merchant.

title: Ball Pit Simulator
description: YOU ARE TRAPPED IN A CURSED BALL PIT, HOW WILL YOU ESCAPE? Ball Pit Simulator is the first game to take place entirely in the realms of a ball pit however, it is not all fun and games. There is only one rule in the ball pit, don't touch the green balls!

title: Nebuchadnezzar
description: Nebuchadnezzar is a classic isometric city builder game inviting players to experience the mysterious history and culture of ancient Mesopotamia. In the campaign, players get to rule over influential historical cities filled with magnificent monuments.

title: Quantumleaper
description:
In Quantumleaper, you'll use your Superposition ability to solve puzzles that would be otherwise impossible to complete. Duplicate your position with a single button and press it again to switch between your two selves at any time, no matter how far.
You can use your other self to activate switches, mislead enemies and block projectiles. Sometimes, even tunnel through walls. As you progress, new components will require you to find new ways to advance – using both intelligence and skill. It's a huge maze filled with deadly puzzles.

title: Master of Pottery
description: Master of Pottery is a pottery-themed creation + simulation game. Create unique works and run your own exhibition hall.

title: Paul's World
description: Paul's World is an Old-School RPG game. We designed this game for mini rpg & survival fans. Farming, crafting, combat, fishing, mini games and more, just explore it! Monsters, wild animals, aliens... Who do you think will win?

title: Mr Zig
description: Do whatever a Zig can with Mr Zig, a adventure game where you must traverse a strange, warped and rotting world littered with succulent meats and techno medicine ripe for the picking.

title: Vaporum: Lockdown
description: Vaporum: Lockdown, a prequel to Vaporum, is a grid-based dungeon crawler RPG in an original steampunk setting, inspired by old-school classics of the genre. Follow the story of Lisa Teller, a scientist struggling to survive disastrous events that happened in the tower of Arx Vaporum.

title: The Legend of Dark Witch Renovation
description:
The Legend of Dark Witch is a 2D platform action game. Zizou can learn new attacks by defeating bosses. She will need every one of those attacks if she is going to save the world.

Updates in Renovation include:
- New character illustrations and revamp pixel art spites to high-resolution
- New Animations
- Added the minigames "Avoid Runner" and "Breakers"
- New Boss arrangements to change attack patterns
- Added Capacity System from Ep2
& more!

title: Boot Camp Fitness
description: Boot Camp Fitness is a cardio and bodyweight fitness game, focused on helping you become the fittest, leanest version of yourself. Including over 200 exercise variations and a 100+ song playlist. With 13 ranks and 18 exercise locations to unlock. No exercise equipment needed.

title: Raiohgar: Asuka and the King of Steel
description: Having cornered the evil organization Trizon, our hero Kouta and his partner Asuka move to the remote island of Okikeshima with their trusted super robot RaiOhGar to prepare for a fierce battle against Trizon. However, all is not quite as it seems.

title: The Looter
description: The Looter is 2D, action/adventure, pixel art, postapocalyptic indie game.

title: Time Fragments: 24h in Capua
description: Time Fragments: 24h in Capua is an adventure RPG game set in 73 BC during the famous slave rebellion in Capua lead by the infamous Thracian soldier Spartacus. You have 24h to find your missing friends.

title: Card Hog
description: Card-based dungeon crawler with pigs, boss fights and all kinds of adventures! Free demo with full content available!

title: SuperEpic: The Entertainment War
description: Join a raccoon and a llama in their quest to save videogames as we know them! SuperEpic is a Metroidvania style action-adventure game filled with humour and satire. The gameplay is nonlinear and fast-paced, with exploration and combo-based combat being the weapon of choice against the evil RegnantCorp!

title: Iron Sun
description: Hardcore and old-school, grim, dark sci-fi first person shooter.

title: Disc Golf Adventure VR
description: Disc Golf in VR for when you can't (or don't want to) play outside!

title: Killer Gin
description: Classic Epic Fantasy Adventure - A JRPG with optional dating and farming mechanics

title: Misc Timelines
description: Drag and drop the historic events cards onto the timeline, arranging them from earliest to latest. Put all the events in correct chronological order to beat the level and unlock the next challenge.

title: Legend of Everything
description: A mind-bending isekai other-world science adventure! On a quest to rescue the Princess from the Demon Lord, Brane encounters an eccentric young woman claiming to be from another world—one with “RPGs” and “video games”!? Epic battles, loveable heroines, and real scientific theory!

title: The Strange Story of Brian Fisher: Chapter 1
description: This is the story of detective Brian Fisher who after the disappearance of his father, makes his life mission to find him...alive! His father is a scientist and disappeared under suspicious circumstances. Brian is eager to find his father and devotes his life to find out why and how he disappeared, with his only hope to find him alive.

title: Gods of Love: An Otome Visual Novel
description: The healer Thalia has developed magical powers and the gods of her world think she might be a new goddess they can marry. Poor Thalia just wants to do her work!

title: High School Otome
description: Sabrina is your average teenager. However she has a troubled relationship with her grandmother, who is her only family guardian after her parents died in a car accident. Things only get worse when Sabrina hears the devastating news that her Grandmother has cancer.

title: Artificial Extinction
description: You have 9 days to find a safe place on the planet. Your ship is low on fuel and you have to land. Setup sentry guns around you to defend yourself while you collect more fuel for the ship. AI controlled Drones and Tanks attack you trying to find weaknesses in your defenses.

title: Grand Academy II: Attack of the Sequel
description: Seize your destiny and vanquish your rivals at the world's finest evil preparatory school! The whole gang is back for a deliciously meta sequel.

title: Death and Taxes
description: In this 2D, narrative-based game, you assume the role of the Grim Reaper... on an office job. Your job is to decide which people are going to live or die. The consequences of your choices are yours to bear, while the mystery of your incarnation awaits revelation!

title: Road to Nowhere
description: You are a policewoman, but with the occurrence of a murder you become a murderer! The victim is a master who loves you deeply! You're innocent! How should you deal with the sudden planting of false accusation? How do you escape? It all depends on your choice.

title: Babel Climbers
description: A round-robin Roguelike game, with a lively rhythm and unique flavor. You were born in a tower, with a mission, climbing one level at a time of adventure, and like other climbers, you want to find the level of heaven. However, this is a bizarre world, which is an adventure that can not be turned back.

title: Natural Instincts
description: Protect the environment, and save it from harm! Give commands to the animals, observe their rituals and help them survive. Face different disasters, react to human presence and help the animal kingdom flourish in this unique, environmental experience!

title: Fairytale Mosaics: Beauty and Beast
description: Solve 120 enchanted mosaics! Bring the prince and kingdom back to normal before the final enchanted rose petal falls!

title: Mystery Solitaire: Arkham's Spirits
description: Solve the most mystical layouts you've ever seen!

title: Piping Hot
description: Your classic pipe-connecting game, turned up to 11! Switch between floors of pipes as you race against the flowing water to get to the end! Play in Unlimited mode for never-ending pipe-connecting fun!

title: Shades of Heroes
description:
With the world descending into chaos... will you protect the light?... or consume it?...
Choose your side... Good or Evil!

title: Dimensionality 3.5
description: Each of us is a celestial body in the vast universe. When our hero is on a common track in his life, this track takes him to another dimension.

title: Dairy Princess
description: その名作の『ラクノープリンセス』はいよいよSteamに登場しました！『ラクノープリンセス』は酪農シミュレーションゲームです。プレイヤーは街外れの牧場を経営する女の子となります。

title: Detective Solitaire Inspector Magic
description: 120 unique deals – investigate a mysterious crime!

title: Exphelius: Arena
description: The Exphelius Championships are a long-standing series of ruthless arena fights between high-tech space vessels. Clever engineering paired with quick reflexes makes the deadly duo on the ladder. Only one person walks out alive. Are you up to the challenge?

title: Red Evil
description: Alice returned to her hometown after a long journey. But nobody was there. Save the inhabitants and defeat the leader of the gang.

title: Mulite Sword Man
description: MULITE is a light action role-playing game that focuses on the collocating of operation and gameplay. The game provides a lot of equipment and skills. Based on the retro action role-playing game mechanism and combined with the Rogue-lite elements, this game abandons the traditional RPG lengthy dialogues and boring tasks, enabling players...

title: Traps Ahead!
description: A 2D platformer game. Try to avoid tricky obstacles and get the chest!

title: Boomerang X
description: Armed with a magical boomerang, slice, fly, and dive through flocks of evil creatures in this acrobatic arena shooter. Obliterate wave after wave and journey ever downwards into the shadows.

title: Lee Inside TV
description: Lee Inside TV is a mix between a one screen platformer and a puzzle game, where gameplay is always changing and each level fells unique. Think outside the box and use the classical mechanics of platformer games to solve puzzles and or finish the level.

title: Space Carrot
description: Arcade game about collecting carrot growing on asteroids. Perfect way to spend 5 minutes while waiting for something. Best played with a gamepad.

title: The Wilds of Dacrima: Field Notes from a Poorly Supervised Alchemist and his Clockwork Robot Companion
description: Uncover the secrets of the forest in this tale of two unlikely friends, with alchemist Edric Tayte and L-P1N. Forage for weird and wonderful ingredients, brew Potions to empower you with potent abilities, and all the while discovering that this adventure isn't quite what it seems..

title: Lands of Pharaoh: Episode 1
description: Lands of Pharaoh is a multi-camera-angle based adventure game. The hero, Heragos, tries to get to Cairo in order to find the messages, related to his divine duty, left for him by Nefertiti.

title: Knights of Light: The Prologue
description: Action adventure role playing game during medieval age in Middle East. Story is based on a historical battle at the 7th century in Iraq. Inspired by The Witcher and Mount & Blade with a rich story with two playable characters. Relive the battle events and lead your troops to victory.

title: Katana Kata
description: Indie souls-like with innovative fight system where you practice your Katana on the path for endless improvement; again and again.

title: Cursed Pagoda
description: Classic Freecell Solitaire combined with the unique story of a mysterious tower filled with traveling spirits! Play through more than 250 stages to unlock the memories of those trapped inside. Plus an Unlimited Freecell Mode!

title: Solar Panic: Utter Distress
description: Solar Panic is a first-person comedy adventure game. Follow a true story that we made up and explore exotic places filled with funny and/or stupid encounters. Wield top-notch gadgets and meet weird and socially awkward characters as you stumble upon a SERIOUS mystery.

title: The Amazing T.K's Suburban Nightmares
description: Return of the Slashers! The nightmarish events are starting up again due to a serial killer worshiping cult-like group on the rise calling themselves H.A.T.E (Humans.Are.Truly.Evil). Delancy Dekker, now P.I, returns to her childhood suburban neighborhood while on a new case that seems all too familiar.

title: Prop and Seek
description: Prop and seek is a hide and seek game which 16 players take turns to hide or seek. You can be a prop to hide or be a hunter to find all hidden props.

title: Fairy Godmother Stories: Cinderella - Collector's Edition
description:
This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:

• Rescue Red Riding Hood’s Grandmother in the bonus game!
• Inspect hidden cabinets, concoct potions, and more by replaying HOPs and mini-games and earn achievements!
• Tons of magic shoes, moonstones, and morphing objects to find!
• Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, music, videos, and more!
• Never get lost with the strategy guide!

title: Bogatyr
description: Bogatyr is a third-person action RPG set in a fantasy setting of Ancient Russia. The main character-a great warrior who returned from a ten-year war on the Southern Borders finds his native land in desolation. The hero will have to deal with what happened in the district, participate in the Civil War and defeat the Ancient evil.

title: Acid Knife
description: Battle Death Centipedes in the melting psychedelic void. Slower, more intentional side-scrolling combat, with an emphasis on positioning and improvisation.

title: The Drifter
description: The Drifter is a point-and-click adventure in the classic style. Taking cues from the second wave of the genre, there's an emphasis on story, with puzzle-solving being the glue that ties it together rather than the focus. Mick's a pretty practical guy, and so puzzles are down-to-earth, designed to be unobtrusive and give an investigative feel. The pacing is quick and lean, and you'll never be wandering around lost for long periods. Mick is propelled through the story at a good clip from one situation to another, with barely a moment to catch his breath.

title: A.I.M. War Protocol
description: "AIM: War Protocol" is a sequel to "AIM 2: Clan War". You are artificial mind that moves around the world using a hover. A huge world awaits you, full of dangers, quests, challenges. Communicate, fight, trade, explore!

title: Averon Rising
description: Averon is a futuristic empire building game that gives players agency to create and direct a nation in anyway they want to roleplay.

title: Day in the Life of a Harpy
description:
Day in the Life of a Harpy is a short but sweet story of a harpy girl that was wandering out late and must get home before dinner.

The game features moderately paced platforming, lighthearted visuals, and upbeat music.

The main protagonist, Duri, has various skills that can help her fend off creatures that threaten her. Her main method of attack is to shoot feathers from her wings, but she has other methods, such as a bag that she can use to capture and throw enemies. She can use her wings to keep her in the air, though, being young, she can only flap them several times before she needs to rest on the ground again.

This adventure takes the player through a variety of stages that are simplistic and fun in their own ways. Day in the Life of a Harpy is a short , but uplifting experience.

title: Anonymous Player
description: Guide Albert on a long and winding path and help him save his world. Get to know his friends and discover the mystery of destruction. You are not just a player. You are a friend of Albert, and if you wish, you can also be a friend of the developer.

title: Blue Boy: Bleeding Out
description: Blue Boy: Bleeding Out is a short but challenging platformer where you bleed as you run. Avoid touching your bloody path on the way to the exit...

title: Krystopia: A Puzzle Journey
description: Follow Nova Dune, a space explorer in her quest to find out about the unfamiliar distress signal she received aboard her ship. Determined to investigate it, she finds herself on a desolated planet where all civilization has vanished.

title: Remember, Lights Out
description: Can you survive using just your memory? Play this short and sweet game to put your memory to the test! Light is your resource, and it will disappear over time. As you collect orbs, your world will go dark. You'll have to remember the level's design to find the escape.

title: Super Novel Collector (Speedrun Edition)
description: Super Novel Collector is a 2D Platform game built for speedrunning. It features an inbuilt timing and split system. It can also be played casually and with a random level generator. Xander, a descendant of the last librarian of Alexandria, seeks to correct the error of his ancestor and restore the library.

title: Creme de la Creme
description: Climb to the very top of the class at your exclusive private school for socialites! Will you study hard, find a perfect match, or embrace scandal?

title: Unlock the King
description: A originally designed puzzle game inspired by Chess. Move the pieces and create a path to Unlock the King.

title: Colorgrid
description: Colorgrid is a puzzle game about mixing colors in a Lab. Find the correct positions for your lasers and mirrors to get the right mix of colors in each material.

title: Vega Motions: Project Unleashed
description: A 3rd person, 1 vs 1 skills-based fighting game set in a destructible arena.

title: Fulfillment
description: Exciting Adventure About the Joys of Working at an Amazin' Fulfillment Center! Short, social commentary game that is 100% free, no micro-transactions.

title: Silicomrades
description: Silicomrades is a couch co-op shooter for two players about malfunctioning robots fighting against unstoppable bureaucracy. Build your own robots from parts providing different bonuses as well as potential defects. Fight the evil robo-politicians and fall apart but do not fall back!

title: Short Scary Stories
description: Shoot, reload and continue. Watch the dark corners.

title: Bot Net: Ramshackle Robotics
description: "Build your bots, command your army, defeat the invaders!" 'Bot Net: Ramshackle Robotics' is a turn-based strategy rogue-like where you'll build an army of ramshackle robots to fight off an alien invasion!

title: Big Red Hood: Halloween
description: Match-2. Erotic adventures with maidens of different kinds, intrigues, and epic final await you. The game will impress as the fans of visual novels, so as good puzzle lovers.

title: Lab 7: Cold Nights
description: In LAB 7: Cold Nights - wise foresight decides on the outcome of your fate. Wasted coins, reckless use of electricity, and poor time management will lead to your demise. Explore your surroundings, build defenses and find a way to freedom.

title: Robber's Horror
description: A horror escape game set in an abandoned hospital. Aim to escape while hiding from the murderer wandering in the stage.

title: The Secret of Hutton Grammar School
description: Uncover the secrets of a mysterious cult in The Secret of Hutton Church of England Grammar School: VGA Edition!

title: IKO 39
description: IKO 39 is an adventure sci-fi detective. Find out what happened at the station, which had lost contact with the Earth. Emie – the artificial intelligence of the station – will help you to solve the mystery.

title: Endless Knight
description: Endless Knight is an unusual fighting game inspired by the black knight scene from the Python classic 'The Holy Grail'. The game sees you cutting opponents' limbs off in a fight to the death!

title: Gangsta Sniper 3: Final Parody
description: Last part of gangsta shooter series. Destroy enemies and finish levels in this meme shooter by finding magic key..

title: Igor Maks: The Meme Lord
description: A fascinating 2D space shooter based on memes. Set off an amazing journey with Igor Maks and reveal the secret of the universe!

title: Nauseous Pines
description: Nauseous Pines is the story of two nightschool students, united by fate and charged with creating their very first video game project.

title: Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire: Collector's Edition
description: Take a deep dive into the magical undersea world of Atlantis Solitaire! Voyage across 400 (!) submarine levels and restore 10 breathtaking Aquascapes. Unlock 18 bonus solitaire variants and enjoy playing 100 levels of a fully featured Mahjong game.

title: Hold Your Ground
description: Hold Your Ground is a Virtual Reality Archery Defense game, in which You, the sole defender of your keep, need to hold off multiple waves of increasingly numerous enemies!

title: Neko-Nin ExHeart 3
description:
This is the third game in Whirlpool’s Neko-nin exHeart series.

It’s been a few months since the cute nekomimi ninjas Yura and Tama came from Fuuma Village to serve the protagonist. Ritsu and Maya have joined them since and their time together have become even more happy and lively. But as expected, a wind of change is in the air.

“I am the next leader of the Saikashu, the successor of Magoichi…. Saika Himari!”

The haughty girl was accompanied by two attendants. What is her objective and what is the Saikashu? The third act has started for this modern ninja cat drama.

title: Lost Existence
description: Explore vast, forgotten lands, banishing ancient horrors, in this open-world voxel action-RPG. Create your own uniquely crafted character class. Build custom multiplayer dungeon, PvP, or siege experiences. Run, vault, and leap effortlessly across endless wilderness, or delve deep underground.

title: Roman Adventures - Britons. Season 2
description: Fearless General Flavius with his detachment cleared the land of Britons from filth. However, it was not enough. The source of evil itself. To this end, the Romans went on a perilous journey through the portal between the worlds.

title: Trial and Terror
description: Surreal, abstract and dark puzzle featuring simple yet challenging mechanics. The retro maze awaits!

title: Framing Dawes
description: Join Bay Dawes and her dead pet rabbit, Dink on their fairy-tale adventure to discover who is Framing Dawes. Talk to inanimate objects, time travel and cast spells while you explore the beautiful 2D hand-drawn world.

title: Hexadrift
description: Traverse your way through 11 unique sector maps collecting the resources you need to repair your busted ship. Optimize your fuel usage, plan maximized routes, and watch out for swarming enemies! Hexadrift is a casual 2D-game of strategic planning and evasion!

title: Try not to die
description: Simple shooting game, using your skills and talent to survive as long as you can.in different types of maps, using different guns to defeat the enemys to collect scores and ammos. With the level getting higher,the number of emenys will increase constantly.As the level gets higher and higher, the game will get harder and harder.

title: Gunk
description: Gunk is an endless rouge-lite wave survival game. Fight off hordes of enemies and level up your skills to increase your chance of survival, and save the world from the Gunk invasion. Their only weakness is rocks, and you are the last hope for humanity. Can you save us all?

title: The Paperman
description: The Paperman is a Virtual Reality game for all the horror lovers. In the game you'll have to explore all the levels facing the challenges you encounter.

title: An Egg Can Dream
description: Everyone has a dream, even an egg. Roll your way around to live out your dreams in a world where you don't always belong.

title: Touhou Ibunseki: Ayaria Dawn - ReCreation
description: A classical Monopoly-like game with 20+ Touhou characters and 10+ official maps. Custom level editor, double resource system (money & crystal), electric dispatching, SP required dice throwing and weather system bring you a whole different game experience. Original characters are waiting for your challenge!

title: Esperia ~ Uprising of the Scarlet Witch ~
description: Dive into the world of Esperia, a fantasy tactical RPG with visual novel elements! Lead Diana and her allies into grid-based tactical battles to uncover the secrets of the Kingdom and the world.

title: Galactic Ruler
description: Galactic Ruler offers real time strategy game play at both planetary level and in space! Lead your faction in diplomacy or conquest across a procedurally generated galactic map where any system might hold hostile enemies or resource riches.

title: Tactical Nexus
description: [BIG VOLUME PUZZLE RPGs/魔塔]It is a game to explore puzzle dungeon that takes more than several hours in one play.There are 12 dungeons, and by purchasing all DLCs, the total number of dungeons will be 60.You can get items according to the dungeon's score, and you can use the items in other dungeons.

title: Every Day's Different
description: "Every Day's Different" is an English voiced visual novel that focuses on slice of life with a more realistic depth. It ranges from romance to heavy topics such as eating disorders and self-worth. The people around you will either benefit or suffer due to your actions, so please choose carefully.

title: The Defender: Farm and Castle 2
description: You are a magician who will protect the castle from the invasion of monsters. Manage your resources, Upgrade skills and build the castle, Increase your population and prepare to deal with more powerful enemies.

title: Risnuch
description: Slash the enemies, improve yourself, join to arena, kill monsters, skeletons, golems.Join the infinity adventure of the Risnuch!

title: Two Weeks in Painland
description: Two Weeks in Painland is a story-driven game about a run-of-the-mill hacker spying on gangsters who are anything but, all while trying to keep his life and limbs in the process. Easier said than done.

title: Asylum of the Dead
description: Asylum of the Dead is a first person zombie shooting survival game.

title: Protect Your Fool
description: In the role of a guardian protector of the fool, practice and enhance your mouse skills, use your reflexes and quick thinking and make your way through the leaderboard in this brain-melting and unique arcade game.

title: P1r4t3s
description: Gather a fearsome crew and sail the space boarding ships and stations, robbing them naked, and shooting whoever stands in your way in the roguelike with RPG elements P1r4t3s!

title: Flat Form Fighter
description: Chaotic slapdown in a dark universe!

title: Marisa's Marvelous Magic Shop
description:
A Touhou novel-style management simulation.
Enjoy the comical interactions between Marisa and her friends, as you earn money to pay back your loan.

The publisher of this game on Steam is DLsite Official.

title: Shape Shooter
description: Shape Shooter provides you an action-packed, satisfying, colorful, and hectic roguelike experience. Survive increasingly difficult random generated stages and collect relics, weapons, and active items to help you on your way.

title: Gred
description: A young child from a road sign has been lost and your goal is to find him ! Incarn BOTH green and red light men and use their powers to switch time and voyage through multiple environments to save him.

title: Stratoscape
description: Stratoscape is a challenging and addictive stationary wave shooter exclusively for VR. Beat your high score as you blast waves of robots and creatures in this solo adventure campaign. Teleport through 8 unique levels, and enjoy some sick techno music on your journey! Just remember... don't look down!

title: BeatAim
description: BeatAim is a rhythm game designed for FPS players with AI generated maps. It makes improving your aim incredibly fun while listening to your favorite songs. Open any music and customize level generation. Combination of osu! and KovaaK's trainer.

title: Thanks For Listening
description: "Thanks for Listening" is a short story-driven game that gives the player the chance to help four radio hosts with their lives.

title: Cucumber Defense VR
description: Because of the abuse of fertilizer hormones, many mutant pests appeared on the planet, sweeping the whole planet of fruits and vegetables. And your vegetable garden will be their next goal. You now have the fate of the whole planet in your hands. grab up your weapons and protect the final fruits.

title: KingSim
description: Become the King in a story-driven 8-bit style game, where choice matters. And try not to die instantly...

title: Manic
description: Manic is a thrilling and brutal action game where you must fight off swarms of enemies whilst seeking vengeance against the mysterious group that murdered your family.

title: GolfTopia
description: DESIGN, BUILD and MANAGE your own futuristic golf course. Keep 200 persistent visitors fed, hydrated, and happy. Defend your creation from a growing infestation of weeds with robotic workers and defensive turrets. Evolve your course into a mega resort where nobody wants to go home, EVER!

title: Chaos Galaxy
description: A pixel-art turn-based Galaxy total war game. You can select 14 factions, 54 heroes, hundreds of warships and mecha, and command multiple fleets to carry out great strategic operations on the map of the galaxy.

title: Jazz Age
description: It's 1926 and there's no place on Earth like New York City. You left the small town you grew up in to seek fame, fortune, and romance on Broadway, but success and true love will both proven more elusive than you imagined in this indie adventure, text based RPG.

title: Eternal Dread 2
description: The world was at the edge of despair. Driven to the brink of extinction, mankind exhausted all their able-bodied men in a futile war against the demon hordes, leaving behind only the female, the young and the vulnerable. And so it came to the women to take up arms and protect what remains of humanity.

title: TAL: Wizard's Adventures
description: TAL: Wizard's Adventures follows the adventure of a young wizard’s apprentice. With your help, Phineas has to go through burdens and trials for achievement one main goal. Our hero wants to gain true wizard attribute - the magic hat.

title: I will eat you
description: I will eat you! Run, hide, shout and try to survive in the game, full of fun and funny moments. Play with random players or with friends. But whatever you do, DO NOT ENTER THE DEN OF THE BEAST!

title: Void of Heroes
description: Mech battle royale and team deathmatch! New type of battle royale mode, built around a vertically rising death zone, instead of the common constricting circle!

title: Battle Sorcerer
description: - Online magic battle VR game, "Battle Sorcerers" -Devise your own tactics and win death-defying battles!The power of creation lies within your hands.

title: The End of an Actress
description: A tragic love story about a feckless queen and an impoverished revolutionary, based on the life (and death) of Marie Antoinette.

title: Star Police
description: Tower Defense game

title: Starship Horizons Bridge Simulator
description: Starship Horizons is a multi-player experience allowing 2-6 players commanding a Starship as the bridge officers in the roles of Captain, Flight, Tactical, Science, Operations, and Engineering.

title: The Otterman Empire
description: The Otterman Empire is an intense quick-fire party shooter for one to four players. Working as a team, you must gear up, strap on your jetpack and stop the evil Tiko in his tracks, an otter who just doesn't give a dam! Jet off across the galaxy and stop his experiments from causing havoc in otterspace!

title: Trapped in Fear
description: You are a child that wakes up alone in the middle of the dark and rainy night in your room. You and your family have moved into recently. If you're curious what happens next, immerse yourself into the world of Trapped In Fear!

title: Dupli_City
description: A cyberpunk narrative game in which you use your psychic powers to stop a megacorp's evil A.I. Send your party members on missions, help them make critical relationship decisions, and earn their trust. Also vampires and a robot cat.

title: Slime Slam
description: A classic take on match 4 puzzle games from the 90's. With 4 gameplay modes and local multiplayer, this fast-paced challenging puzzler will keep you on your toes! Highly customizable options for any style of play.

title: Country Clubbing
description: Are your lack of golf skills stressing you out? Are you slicing when you’d rather be beating the other players? Are local gopher populations threatening the well being of your local ranges? Well then, why not try Country Clubbing! Swing to your heart’s content and throw caution (and par) to the wind!

title: PuPaiPo Space Deluxe
description: Hop into your spaceship and battle waves of opponents in your journey to find the legendary space pizza! Now 100% more Deluxe than ever!

title: Epic World
description: Epic World is a Platformer action game with tricky elements, hidden treasures and dangerous enemies. You become an adventurer exploring a continuously evolving levels to recapture the stolen gold from the orcs king.

title: Dark Skies: The Nemansk Incident
description: A hardcore shooter with unforgiving mechanics and deep atmopshere. Every step could be your last. Set in the fictional Nemansk Region in southeast of Russia, your task is to find information about a meteorite and a missing science team.

title: Two Worlds II HD: Shattered Embrace
description: Return to Antaloor for a brand new adventure in the Two Worlds saga! When the ancient Elves resurface on a remote island, an old secret leads to the rise of a new evil. Racing against time, you must travel to the depths of hell and back before secrets of the past destroy the future of the land!

title: Reign of Darkness
description: Reign of Darkness still very much being developed but currently is a "Tab Target", "Theory-Crafting", "Dungeon Runner", and Online Role Playing Game. Being based on classic D&D principles & concepts, where every attack is a virtual roll of the dice, players can "Build" or...

title: D20 Dungeons
description: Enjoy detailed turned-based combat using the 3.75 OGL version of the world's oldest roleplaying game. Create your own characters and send them off on battles you create yourself. Choose from various arenas to fight in. When you're done, head back to town to rest up and equip yourself for the next battle!

title: Orb Rivals
description: Sci-fi football and jet-powered hockey collide in the intergalactic sport of Orb.

title: Nubarron: The adventure of an unlucky gnome
description: Guide Gnome across the dangers of this twisted fairytale world. Can you break the curse that made that annoying cloud appear? Can you recover his stolen Lucky Hat? Can you trust your friends? Find out in Nubarron, a casual puzzle platformer set in a beautiful digitally painted world full of weird creatures you'll have to deal with.

title: Isle of Dinosaurs 2D
description: You got teleported into a prehistoric world. It's time to show the inhabiting dinosaurs why you are not extinct and return back home.

title: Plasmoid
description: 24 levels of hell. The goal of the game is to collect crystals of the same color in a row. Aim wisely, collect combos, get bonuses.

title: The Floor Is Still Really Cheap Lava
description: Avoid randomly placed cheap lava and collect various power-ups along the way to see how far you can get! Multiple game modes are now available.

title: Foodtruck Arena
description: Foodtruck Arena an unconventional mix of car combat and football game, combines two things that make the world go round: food and sports. Become one of the legendary chefs, take part in an unforgettable tournament, battle against formidable opponents, and climb to the top of the culinary world!

title: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2020
description: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2020 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite professional basketball team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents all the way to making each substitution to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

title: Super Lobster Run
description: Embark on an Epic Journey as Laughy the Lobster

title: Kumo: The Little Robot
description: Help Kumo get out of the tower Go through more than 100 levels in this game requiring reflexes and skill

title: Cave Confectioner
description: Turn cavemen into consumers with the discovery that shaped an age -- sugar. Farm crops, discover new recipes, and sell baked goods in this back-to-the-land agricultural business simulation.

title: Meandering Fiend
description: Explore tons of unique mazes with lots of places to get lost and turned around. Can you find your way through all the mazes and find the secret items scattered throughout?

title: Null Drifter
description: Null Drifter is a 1BIT LO-FI shooter, a journey into the void inside a computer simulation! Lose yourself in this frenetic yet chill experience!

title: Dragon Stone: Legendary Archer
description: This game is a hero defense game where you have to collect items and raise your hero's stats quickly in order to stop the monsters which getting stronger gradually.

title: Project Ara - Crucible
description: Project Ara - Crucible is a bullet hell type shoot’em’up featuring procedural content generation in addition to light RPG elements. Help Lethe Zelmiya, the forgetful wizard on her epic quest to graduate from the Myrellian Academy of Magic.

title: Yuki Onna
description: Yuki Onna is a PS1 inspired survival horror game. Some children went missing out of the blue. You receive a letter that says, "Come alone or I'll freeze them to death." Out of desperation, you decide to embark on a daunting rescue mission to an abandoned inn up the piercing cold mountains.

title: Pull Stay
description: Pull Stay is a wacky Beat 'em up game with Tower Defense mechanics. Use your fists or set crazy traps to repel enemies from rushing into your house! Defend your buddy Susumu, who goes out of his house only once in every two months for his haircut!

title: The Ugly Christmas Sweater Game
description: You are an elf: Alone and running out of magic. Your only hope is to get to the mall and catch a ride with Santa, but you won't be able to stay invisible long enough to get to the mall. Everyone is wearing ugly Christmas sweaters. Who will notice an extra elf in a sweater? Time to get sweater hopping to the mall!

title: Race Race Racer
description: Feel the rush as you tear down the track at breakneck speeds in a thrilling car race to the finish.

title: Vile Matter
description: Trapped in a deteriorating world of mystery, navigate a series of challenges & deadly puzzles in pursuit of a mysterious figure that's always one step ahead. Can you outwit this prison of shadows and survive long enough to find an answer to the madness? Or, will you fail and be consumed by the darkness?

title: Awesome Pea 2
description:
Greedy Pea is back in game! Dark dungeons, deadly traps, everything is green, a lot of gold everywhere!

Awesome Pea 2 - next chapter of classic platformer game. Greedy Pea is back in game! Now even more dark dungeons, deadly traps and gold!

title: Hope's Farm
description: Match your way through an incredible farming adventure. Grow crops, plant trees, raise adorable animals and customize a wonderful farm.

title: Runner Heroes: The Curse of Night and Day
description: RUNNER HEROES is a unique adventure in which you control two characters at the same time. Play in single mode or with a friend in two cooperative modes. Addiction and challenge at full speed through 47 levels. Do you accept the challenge?

title: Paunch
description: With 12 lives for two, players must fight to gain points from each kill. The containers of life are boulders freely moved by characters in the arena and used for throwing. In hand-to-hand combat the characters interact using their muscles and initiate targeted hits.
