description: Stage 0 is a puzzle-based VR room escape adventure game.

title: Ballance: The Return
description: Classic theme, more than classic. Hardcore gameplay, smooth sense of control, with breakthrough game performance, open the imagination of the puzzle, let people fondly.

title: Null & Peta -Invasion of the Queen Bug-
description: The crazy comedy anime Null & Peta has been reborn as a thumb-threatening action adventure! Featuring sisterly cooperation, gorgeous event CGs—and plenty of secrets to explore!?

title: Wienne
description: Wienne is unique - you can change the flow of the story at any moment in time. Repeatedly. In this short story and lore-driven RPG you will have to save Wienne and Zack from a nearly inevitable demise. Can you find the path?

title: The Shenanigans of Cherry and Trix
description: The Shenanigans of Cherry and Trix follows the story of one amnesiac little ghost and her new loner troll friend. With the hit of a button, swap control between the two heroines on their journey to discover what it means to truly live.

title: Nostalgiarian
description: Nostalgiarian is an old school platform game which you can jump, climb, run, fight... Improve your reflexes. It is short game to casual gamers. In Nostalgiarian you will remember your childhood.

title: Room Escape '1053'
description: Solve the quest, Get out of the HouseHorror Room Escape VR Adventure Game You are going to be a famous BJ, get the key.If you can't solve that quest, you are going to stay that creepy house forever.I wish you couldn't go inside...

title: End of War 1945
description: End of War 1945 is a WW2 FPS focusing on 6v6 classic casual gameplay (Support for up to 32 players), intense action, open and unique maps, and a historically authentic setting. The Early Access release is set in Germany, Yugoslavia, and Italy during the final months of the war.

title: Goblin Times
description: In this joyful Steampunk world, Goblins are the absolute dominators. They have their own ways of living. Money and power is what makes this world go around and also every goblin’s ultimate pursuit. Some goblins who are good at making money become leaders of the pack.

title: War Robots: Planet Defender
description: In the distant future, the human beings begin their interstellar travel in the vast universe, and lots of rich planets were mined. But not every planet is peaceful, cruel pirates, wandering rebels, runaway robots, monsters.... We have to face these challenges.

title: One-Eyed Lee and the Dinner Party
description: Help Lee and Beracus escape with their lives from inside a haunted, cult filled bunker! Casual point and click gameplay with a focus on story and character development.

title: Jack-O-Lantern Covers of Darkness
description: The Jack-O-Lanterns have emerged from the underworld and are taking over the world.

title: Bomber Fox
description: Bomber Fox is an action, sci-fi-themed game of the new generation, with an emphasis put into the dynamic gameplay, diverse level design, and innovative game modes.Play as Fox - the space cyborg, who has to win the grand robot-fighting tournament, to be granted a chance to go back home!

title: Tower of Shades
description: Tower of Shades is a short game in which you start at the end of the protagonist's journey, right at the final boss fight.

title: Devil Threats
description: Christopher hit the road to save his daughter Try to find his daughter before you go crazy.

title: The Pale City
description: The Pale City is a story-driven, dark fantasy RPG with an emphasis on characterization and atmosphere. Explore a dangerous, morally complex world where every detail is personal..

title: Crash: Autodrive
description: Crash: Autodrive is a murder mystery game set in the near future where the self-driving Autocab you're in hits a cyclist. As you talk with the other passengers, and use the clues you find to contradict their lies, it becomes clear that you ALL know the victim and have a motive for murder...even the car!

title: Mr.King Luo! Don't Be Kidding
description: To return to the land of the living, I am willing to be the enemy of the entire netherworld! Due to a wrongful conviction, the protagonist has to appeal before the cremation of his physical body is done. But what awaits him at the end of this journey is another preposterous conspiracy...

title: Dead Territory
description: After the nuclear disaster, all living things took on a new form. Your mission: to clear the territory of the undead.

title: Dark Raider
description: When every apocalypse strikes at the same time, three heroes rise to save their doomed world! Raid hundreds of dungeons, hack through waves of enemies, and defeat powerful bosses in this new take to the Hack & Slash RPG genre.

title: Broken of Darkness
description: 30 Heroes, 30+Boss, 30+Boss, 150+ different monsters, 390 Hero's Skills, 300+ Runes, 300+ passive effect for equipment, 500+ synthetic skill scrolls for equipment, Infinite randomly generated equipment Only by matching different equipment and props reasonably can heroes be more powerful.

title: Cave to Kingdom
description: Cave to Kingdom is a cross platform 3D online medieval management & strategy game, featuring a single persistent universe with player driven economy, war, and taxes.

title: Raccoon: The Orc Invasion
description: Racoon lives in a forest with his friends. He had a happy and a joyful life, until in the mountains appeared a portal.From the portal came out some strange creatures he never saw before. They are orcs. Your mission is to protect the forest and your friends from invaders.

title: Gravity Escape from the Maze
description: Gravity Escape From The Maze is a fast-paced action platformer where you control a small square with a curious ability. Escape mazes filled with dangerous traps as you collect keys to continue your journey.

title: Crypto: Against All Odds
description: Command cryptocurrencies to fight against blockchain threats in this stylish, high-action tower defense game. Prices influence the powers of your cryptos in real time. Features squad customization, skill trees, base building, mini-games, and Endless mode. Tip: Keep calm and "HODL" the line.

title: Art of Deception
description: Art of Deception is an interactive killer simulator. Deceive, manipulate, steal, substitute others-all methods are good.

title: Guardians of Rings
description: be a magic hero bear and collect hidden magic rings and avoid different powerful enemies

title: Hello Player
description: A little nice adventure spoiled by bloggers! Help me reach them and make them my friends by using various mechanics of movement! Also game absolutely doesn't have the fourth wall!

title: Armorgeddon
description: Armorgeddon: Test your skills and strategies as an armor commander in levels where the units change every time you play. Landscapes are treacherous in the war torn future that is Armorgeddon.

title: Bottler3000
description: The world is plaqued with plastic. Play this game to show your support to make the earth a cleaner place.

title: The Good Time Garden
description:
In a pink world full of strange naked creatures, the player takes control of a human-looking fellow on a mission to gather food for a friend of his.
Filled with constant disturbing imagery and dark undertones, The Good Time Garden is a short (15-20 minutes long), surreal horror puzzle.

title: Fright
description: Move around a hauntred maze trying to find books of power.

title: PyroNinja: Fire Dodge
description: Dodge fireballs for as long as possible and collect coins.

title: The Walsingham Files - Chapter 2
description: After discovering a major clue concerning the double homicide in Willowdale Nature Reserve, Sara is mysteriously convicted on false bribery charges that brings the investigation to a grinding halt.

title: Portal Dungeon: Goblin Escape
description: Portal Dungeon is a medieval fantasy action game where you have to activation a network of dungeon portals and free yourself from the slavery of the queen.

title: Choco Pixel
description: Choco Pixel is a minimalist colorful puzzle which goal is to get the toy car to the finish using 4 directions in space and avoiding traps.

title: Long Loot the King
description: Pac-Man inspired retro action horror game about a king, who has to face his own made horrors in the dungeons. All because of his greed and selfishness.

title: Knight Swap 2
description: The sequel of the successful Knight Swap, with more levels, more gameplay mechanics and even more fun. The goal in each level is to move the opposing knights to where the others are placed (and vice versa) using the features of the board. Can you swap the Knights?

title: Unlock the King 2
description: The continuation of the successful Unlock The King, now in a tridimensional board. A originally designed puzzle game inspired by Chess. Move the pieces and create a path to Unlock the King.

title: Afterbern Democralypse
description: Brawl for a brighter future!

title: Election simulator
description: Election simulator is a political satire game where you gain Voters by literally throwing cash at problems in society.

title: Drinks With Abbey
description: Drinks with Abbey is a short, slice-of-life visual novel portraying a more realistic first date in western culture, from a male's perspective. After connecting with Abbey on a dating app, you meet in person for the first time at a local bar. Through many choices of what to say and do, you determine how the date goes - and how well it ends.

title: Bryce's Movement Engine 1
description: Be prepared for a trip into yesteryear! Bryce's Movement Engine¹ is an MSDOS Ware meets Post-Trainwreck-era game set in the halcyon days of 1998! An all-new classic adventure, BME¹ is the ultimate tribute to a mega-cool era of awesome gaming!

title: Slender Threads
description: Slender Threads is a point-and-click thriller adventure where unseen forces bind the fate of an unremarkable traveling salesman to the peculiar town he one day arrives in.

title: Réussir: Code de la Route
description: Practice for your driving test and challenge your friends!

title: Ren Qi Dong Man Da Luan Dou
description: 这是一款动漫呆萌与战斗激情完美交融的卡牌手游。

title: Paparazzi Simulator
description: Become the most sought after paparazzi and the fear of celebrities all over the west coast. Take the perfect shot of people who really don’t want their picture taken. Go to great lengths to get the job done, even if you have to resort to less than reputable methods.

title: Escape the Ninja Room
description: You are trapped in Ninja Room. Can you escape from this room? This game is a point click type escape game.

title: Geocells Quadcells
description: Quadcells is a quirky logic puzzle game and is the second game in the Geocells series.

title: Mobius & Elegy Belongs to Nobody
description: The Mobius is an animated visual novel that tells the Tragic Song of uncontrolled desire and destiny

title: Space Digger
description: They only wanted to do their job, but the pigs decided otherwise. Take command of a small spaceship having to dig through waves of asteroids in order to earn your worth. Watch out for the pink menace!

title: Zedfest
description: Zedfest is the goriest game show ever created! A hardcore 4 player co-op third-person shooter with the goal to complete objectives while neutralizing Zeds with lots and lots of visceral gore.

title: Willy Jetman: Astromonkey's Revenge
description: Willy Jetman: Astromonkey's Revenge is an arcade shooter full to the brim with action and shooting, inspired by the console classics of the 90s. A mysterious accident causes an environmental disaster on a faraway planet.

title: Archaelund
description: Explore a vast open world and crawl through dungeons in first person, then fight tactical turn-based battles from a top-down perspective. Guide your adventuring party through Archaelund, mankind's last frontier, and uncover its many secrets.

title: Sloth Quest
description: Control the true king of the jungle as you navigate treacherous vines, battle predators, scale trees and travel to the great beyond. Can you master the precise timing honed by all sloths in the jungle?

title: Taiji
description: Explore a mysterious and detailed world full of puzzles. It is important to think hard and to pay close attention, as vital clues are sometimes hidden in plain sight.

title: Sky Cannoneer
description: An arcade classic reimagined -- build up your fortifications, place your cannons, and fire at the enemy forces! Improve your Battle Haven with powerful upgrades, including new types of Forts, Technologies, Superpowers, and Summons.

title: Buggy Bump
description: Welcome to the Buggy Bump festival. Buggy Bump is a racing experience like no other. Offering moment-to-moment racing in VR or on the screen. Race through the desert festival setting by day and night, Every bump counts as you have to watch out for not just the other drivers but the track itself.

title: Numb
description: Numb will get to you in position to experience some of the sleep phases, through James, a normal person with some stress problem which effect his sleep. Are you ready to live, or die, in a dream? Is it actually a dream, though?

title: One Day
description: Survive for One Day in a valley, where elementals want to kill you. Cast fireballs, avoid water and travel between islands to live as long as you can! Can you do it?

title: Restaurant Solitaire: Pleasant Dinner
description: Make the tastiest dinner and enjoy it!

title: Desert coachman
description: This is a role-playing action game,The player rides in a wagon that carries goods,Skeleton monsters surround the player.Players are free to explore the surrounding area,The player can control the horse to attack the skeleton monster,Players can dodge monster attacks or kill monsters, And must survive as long as possible.

title: Game Breaker
description: You are inside the event horizon where everything is possible unless get out of it. Legends say you have to Break the Game to manifest what is beyond the event horizon. What is beyond the event horizon is unknown. Use and improve variant types of pulse backwards jumps to try to Break the Game.

title: Match Solitaire
description: Combine matching and strategy in a fresh new take on Solitaire! With daily challenges and levels ranging from casual to mind-bending, Match Solitaire has more than 10 million guaranteed-winnable puzzles to meet your skill level and mood.

title: Monster Capture King
description: A monster catching game in black and white! Apply liberally to face and body.

title: Dragon Blazers
description: Dragon Blazers is a mix between 16bit arcade and Toriyama style. You are part of the Dragon Blazers, a team of powerful warriors mastering an ancient martial art technique with a dragon power, fighting against an evil cyber-ninja army that's ruining our beautiful world.

title: Biba's Adventures
description: Only at first glance it may seem that this is a nice, easy and relaxing game, in fact - danger awaits at every turn! Only the most attentive and agile can get to the finish line, leaving Biba`s alive. And the competitive mode will not let anyone get bored.

title: ReversiQuest2
description: ReversiQuest2 is a single-player tactical JRPG with a battle system based on Reversi. Those good ole days of pixel art, characters, and sounds reminiscent of video games of the mid 90's. No need to know the previous ReversiQuest to enjoy ReversiQuest2!

title: Golden Rails: Tales of the Wild West
description: Tame the Wild West as you build a railroad from coast to coast! All you have to do to earn your stars is think ahead and beat the clock! Download Golden Rails: Tales of the Wild West for free and make history as the king of the tracks!

title: Project Speed
description: Project Speed is a 3D Racing Game with multiple maps and vehicles to choose from made with the Unreal Engine. Race against AI or other players.

title: Shoot on Sight
description: The System built a world of injustice and oppression. Pressed up against the wall, it now fights for its survival. Uphold the law as an elite police officer or join the Stagers to liberate the world, defining the future of society in this multiplayer isometric tactical shooter!

title: Touhou Hakanai Cards
description: Touhou Hakanai Cards is a strategy game combining TCG. The card characters are all from the Oriental project. You can use these different styles and distinctive characters to match a variety of lineup combinations. Enjoy well-designed balance and a fun-filled sense of operation, carefully plan the resources in the game, and use beautifully illustrated character cards to play against! It can also support 2-4 people on the PC platform for online battles.

title: Stationflow
description: Stationflow is a game about controlling the flow of thousands of passengers by building and managing an efficient underground train station.

title: Barrage Musical: Basic Danmaku Tutorial
description: A tutorial for shmup beginners. Presented by Lightsaber Fairy.

title: Pieces of Me: Northbound
description: You find yourself standing at a trolley station shortly after midnight. Confused as to where you are, the mystery of how you came to be there will slowly unravel as you interact with those you encounter.

title: Musashi vs. Cthulhu
description: Musashi vs Cthulhu (or MxC) is a fast-paced action game where you take control of Musashi - the most famous warrior from feudal Japan -, as he’s fighting for his life. The samurai is a victim of a terrible curse that makes him a target for unspeakable monsters.

title: Street Jam: The Rise
description: The street fighting circuit needs a new ruler but do you have what it takes? Punch your way through a bloodthirsty and mature world to achieve glory!

title: Streets of Neotokio
description: Neotokio is the capital city of Japan in the year 3020. A place whose control is fought over between two Yakuza clans: the conservative clan Minashigo and the progressive clan Kuroi Taiyo. Put yourself into the position of Kaito, who has to rescue Aiko and recover his lost honour as samurái of the clan Minashigo.

title: Yang2020: Path to Presidency
description: Andrew Yang is unstoppable on his path to presidency! Play through all of the ups and downs of his campaign journey as you battle the other candidates, the naysayers and of course President Trump!

title: Christmas Stories: Enchanted Express - Collector's Edition
description: Can you help the train's passengers save their holidays in time? Find out in Christmas Stories: Enchanted Express - Collector's Edition, an enchanting hidden-object puzzle adventure! This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. Work on a case for the Cat King in the bonus game. Revisit the festive challenges with re-playable HOPs and mini-games, and earn achievements. Search for puzzle pieces and morphing items hidden among the decorations. Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, screen savers, music, a Secret Room Quest, a strategy guide, and more!

title: The Disguiser of Fate
description:
This is a world at the brink of destruction, but he comes from a destroyed world. Bearing the burden of changing the fate of this world and facing everything before him, especially the eminent destruction, what can he do, and what price will he pay?

Windward_Birds' new game, The Disguiser Of Fate. Is a traditional fantasy RPG game.

title: Magic: Legends
description:
A thrilling Action RPG set across the iconic planes of Magic: The Gathering! In Magic: Legends, become immersed in the acclaimed fictional Magic multiverse as a powerful, spell-wielding Planeswalker.

The Magic: Legends servers will cease operation on October 31, 2021, at 11:59pm Pacific.

title: Karryn's Prison
description:
In Karryn's Prison you play as Karryn, the new female Chief Warden of a notoriously lenient prison that has just rioted. Will you subjugate the rowdy inmates through force, or will you be subjugated yourself as your resistance towards their nonstop sexual advances start dropping?

Shape yourself and the prison the way you want to with the Edicts system! Struggle against sexual advances with the Willpower and Desire system! Become more and more vulnerable to sex with the Passives system! The current alpha version has gameplay up to the boss of Level 1.

title: Sengoku Neet
description: Sengoku Neet is a strategy conquest simulation eroge set in the Sengoku era. The game features over 40 characters, with erotic scenes you can experience.

title: The Maid of Fairewell Heights
description: This game is made by Nora using RPG Maker 2000 and it was released on November 22nd, 2007. Is a comedy game packed with minigames and a touching story.

title: Civlands
description: Civlands combines elements from legendary RTS games with epic turn-based strategy games to provide a unique hybrid of tactical, real time strategy, with the grandeur, minutia, and depth of turn-based gameplay.

title: Unnamed SDVX Clone
description: USC is a free rhythm game based on Sound Voltex and KShootMania. It allows the use of custom charts and skins.

title: Clannad: Hikari Mimamoru Sakamichi de - First Volume
description: Clannad: Hikari Mimamoru Sakamichi de First Volume is a linear visual novel featuring full voice-acting (for dialogues and descriptions alike) that tells 8 stories from the world of Clannad that were not covered in the anime series or original game. This release is the first out of two volumes (featuring the first 8 out of 16 overall short episodes).

title: Bad Medicine: Infectious Teachers
description:
“He” was a rational teacher that you looked up to…or at least he was.

There was a dark classroom that one must never set foot into. In there are extremely dangerous special lessons with the teachers.

When you realize the true forms of the teachers…. will you be able to handle it?

title: Receiver 2
description: Receiver 2 simulates every internal part of each firearm based on manufacturer schematics and gunsmithing resources. Learn exactly how each sidearm works, including how to load and unload them, clear malfunctions, and operate their safety features.

title: City Mania
description: Welcome to the best new city-builder game in town! Now is your chance to be the owner of the awesomest city ever! Build, expand, customize -- the decision is in your hands! But don't stop there! Recruit dozens of quirky characters, add them to your collection and watch as they populate the streets and bring your city to life! Certain apps allow you to purchase virtual items within the app and may contain third-party advertisements that may redirect you to a third-party site.

title: Race the Sun: Challenge Edition
description:
You are a solar-powered craft. The sun is your death timer. Hurtle towards the sunset at breakneck speed in a futile race against time. Delay the inevitable by catching speed boosts which reverse the setting sun - if only for a moment. Race The Sun: Daily Challenge Edition is inspired by arcade games of the past with a focus on high scores, short game sessions, and pure fun mingled with nerve-wracking tension. The rules are simple: don't crash, stay in the light, and don't slow down!

This new edition of the game includes several new features including new alternate ships, colorful new trails, and a new "daily challenge" system that will test the skills of even the most experienced players.

title: Death Come True
description:
An authentic full motion video game from Kazutaka Kodaka, creator of the Danganronpa.

Is this a game or a movie? The story reacts to your choices.

The story takes place in a hotel. The main character, Makoto Karaki (Kanata Hongo) is a wanted serial killer. However, he has lost all of his memories. Under such circumstances, when he dies, he has a mysterious ability to “time leap” and return to the past. As he’s being chased like a criminal, who can he trust? Who should he be wary of? What is his true identity? The man searches to find the truth as he repeats decisions and death.

title: Facade
description:
Athmospheric story set in a post-acolyptical world. 
 
"We used to travel the stars, but in a blink of an eye, the ashes covered the earth. 
 
An old space rocket might lead us to a better world." 
 
It was made in 48h for the MiniLD28.

title: Clannad: Hikari Mimamoru Sakamichi de - Last Volume
description: Clannad: Hikari Mimamoru Sakamichi de Last Volume is a linear visual novel featuring full voice-acting that tells 8 stories from the world of Clannad that were not covered in the anime series or the original game. This release is the last out of two volumes (featuring the last 8 out of 16 overall short episodes).

title: Might is Right
description: Might is Right is an old-school turn-based strategy game, it has simple controls and deep complex mechanics.

title: Hotaru
description: Hotaru is a difficult space style shoot 'em up with different waves of enemies, bosses and power-ups.

title: Super 3-D Crunk Bros.
description: Super 3-D Crunk Bros. is an action-adventure platformer which tells the tale of a hash brown named Crunk, his "brother" Paco, and their journey to thwart the plans of a nefarious corporation bent on taking over the world.

title: Pivot
description: A fun casual puzzle game with fruit and machines

title: The Christmas Spirit: Grimm Tales - Collector's Edition
description: Who will save Fairytale land when Dame Gothel threatens to end Christmas forever?

title: BRG's Tale of the Gallant Jiraiya
description: Redemption. Romance. Adventure. All heroes have beginnings, this is the story of the legendary hero Jiraiya, Young Thunder. Jiraiya was an orphan, he quickly turn to a life of crime to survive. He believed in justice, so he stole from the rich and gave to the poor. Witness Jiraiya's legend unfold!

title: Phantom Detective
description: 高一下半学期，和同学们一起乘大巴去春游的我，不幸卷入了一场离奇的车祸，住院治疗了整整两年才得以康复。 本以为大难不死必有后福，却没想到这只是一连串离奇事件的开端…… 同时配合简单易上手的自定义剧情编辑器，把你自己的的故事，在不同的平台，告诉给不同的人听。

title: Endless Ski
description: Relive the Classic 90's era game Ski Free in an re-imagined fun, fast paced skiing game. Don't forget to avoid the Yeti!

title: Cosmic Monsters
description: Experience your Cosmic Monsters adventure as "Victor" in the Kraiga region! The mighty and dark enclave tries to manipulate the sweet Cosmic Monsters for their evil machinations, yours The task is to stop them!

title: The Magician's Workshop
description: When your master is murdered, you must uncover the magical secrets of Renaissance Italy, before your rival apprentices expose them first!

title: Strike Master Apocalypse
description: Strike Master Apocalypse is a 2D action-packed shooter in which you play Bluey, a human who has to survive an apocalyptic landscape. Bluey must endure the wrath of the mutant King Spider and his gang of barons hunting him down, who will try to get him by any means possible.

title: Space Block Buster
description: Find your games asleep in your memories in the world of VR. Space Block Buster contains all the features of the game you used to enjoy in your childhood. Clear stages faster with higher points, using various blocks, rackets, and properties of the ball.

title: Orbitblazers
description:
Get Ready for a Futuristic Adrenaline Rush! 
With Orbitblazers take part in top class futuristic racing never before seen in this form! 
Glide with breakneck speed along futuristic courses and overcome all obstacles that stand in your way! Dominate the racetrack in single or two-player mode.

title: Lost Roads
description: Lost Roads is a psychological horror game in a world where undecipherable mysteries hide, are you ready to start the game?

title: Xtreme Sports
description: The Xtreme Sports showdown has begun! Play as Guppi or her boyfriend Fin as they visit Xtreme Island and aim to become Xtreme Sports Champion by mastering five events - skateboarding, street luge, in-line skating,

title: Corepunk
description: Corepunk is an MMORPG with fog-of-war in a seamless open world. Thanks to the top-down camera and fog-of-war, you'll want to discover every nook and cranny. Corepunk offers a variety of professions, battlegrounds, challenging monsters in unique camps, guilds, farms, quests, and profound lore.

title: The Lie
description: The Lie is an entry in the Puddle Books series. It teaches children ages three to eight the importance of telling the truth. In the main screen, the player can select a storyteller, and navigate through the pages. On each page of the story, the selected storyteller reads the page out loud. Clicking on the picture on the right of the page leads the child to an activity. In some pages, a song will play with animation accompanying it before leading to the activity. The game features reading comprehension and vocabulary.

title: 10 Beautiful Postcards
description:
THE IMAGE IS HOTEL TO THE BRAIN

Check in today!! 10 Beautiful Postcards - a wonderful pile of rubble to sift through on your computer. A resort of many rooms for your eyes and hands to drift around - 200+ mangled collage ruins, flattened into pleasure palaces for you to uncover and explore. Investigate the dimension's mysterious economy. Visit and review multiple themed locations. Take snapshots of your friend, the void - or simply have fun relaxing by the pool. A fun and upbeat game for new wavers of all ages. Won't you come dwell in my house?

title: 1001 Jigsaw: World Tour - France
description: 1001 Jigsaw. World Tour: France is a puzzle game and adventure into the heart of France in 500 high-quality images.

title: Sapper
description: In Sapper, you play a small anti-pirate. mine-sapper unit. Cleanse local home vessels and exotic alien craft of enemies, mines, and watch vast ships ride to safety as you collect your bounty.

title: Crazy Ball Racing
description: Crazy Ball Racing is a game that takes the rush of a race and the skill of a platformer, and combines it with the intensity of a massively multiplayer experience.

title: Rackham's Shambala Adventure
description:
Experience exciting adventures with Joe Rackham, who has settled in China.
Discover Shambala / Shangri-La and exciting puzzles on your way there.

title: Movie Maven: A Tycoon Game
description: With Movie Maven Tycoon lead a mini-major studio to success in an engaging and fully simulated box office environment. Avoid bankruptcy and grow by building up a roster of capable actors, producing ever larger films, securing valuable screenplays, and attracting the best directors.

title: BomberX
description: Take control of atypical characters and blow up as many enemies as possible. Single player or multiplayer, fight for wealth and get equipment that shows your power!

title: Foxfall
description: Welcome to FoxFall! Super Satisfying Adventures waiting to you!

title: The Alchemist's House
description: The Alchemist's House is a 3D interactive horror movie in a creepy medieval setting.

title: Saber Fight VR
description: VR game focused on fighting with laser sword. Slice your opponents to pieces as well as the surrounding. Deflect incoming projectiles and throw your enemies with your powers! Rebuild your destroyed temple and become master again!

title: Dispatch
description: You're called to a mysterious house for a late night medical emergency.

title: Good doktor
description: Game simulator of the work of a general practitioner in a hospital. Your goal is to identify diseases in patients and achieve the highest level. Take care of the routine of the physician, control of coupons and carefully check each incoming patient for the presence of certain diseases.

title: Loathe the Game
description: The Devil has a new minion! Condem sinners to hell all with the flick of the spacebar.Collect souls to power your soul meter and unlock evil upgrades to spawn more minions along the way.Each goal is something special to make the autoclicking expierience worthwhile and satisfying.This is one game that you surely want to miss.

title: Sighchology Research Lab
description: In this game, you play as a student in the Sighchology Research Lab. In this dark place, you do research every night and day without sleep, because you have been given a great mission: to publish a piece of paper...

title: Aloe and Cal
description: Dive into the world of Aloe and Cal and experience a gently paced visual novel about the importance of food. With thousands of fun choices to make, over 100 CGs to look at, and 7 colorful characters to meet, you will undoubtedly walk away satisfied!

title: Six-step Mystery
description: 失意青年刘在机缘巧合下得到了一份离奇的工作，在命运齿轮的推动下，结识了几名性格各异的少女。忽然有一天祸从天降，他卷入了一起绑架案，并被迫参与一场事关生死的游戏。在求生的同时，他不得不重新审视过去生活寻求蛛丝马迹，那看似平静的生活实则早已暗流涌动……

title: Give up the Dupe
description: Give Up The Dupe is a short 10-15 minute sokoban-style puzzle game where you cannot see or being seen by yourself.

title: Drift Masters
description: choose a car and start drift around the city and on the highway, run away from the police chase

title: Human Factory
description: Build a factory to store, process and sell Humans. Sell their meat, skin and souls. Become the greatest cosmic space deity in the multiverse.

title: Dancing Arrow: Beat Smash
description: Dancing Arrow, VR rhythm game where you can enjoy dance games with K-POP music. Dance while listening to your favorite music!

title: IOX
description: Top-down scifi ARPG set in the future around the orbits of Jupiter. You take the role of a mercenary that works contract missions to various corporations operating in the solar system.

title: Glitchangels
description: Experience the thrill of retro arcade shooter action like never before in the pixel perfect arenas of Glitchangels by Pumpkin Games.

title: Hollow Head
description: You wake up to a horrible smell, and whispering vents in your apartment. Something's wrong. Hollow Head is a first person horror adventure game with PS1-style graphics. Experience a dark, intensely oppressive atmosphere and theme - not just a jump scare maze, this one may stick with you after playing.

title: Kedemara: The Orphan's Ballad
description: The story details the comedic and inspiring tale of a girl trying to recall her past, all the while trudging forward with the help of her 3 newfound, whimsical friends. With the simple intent to find out who her parents are, Deirdre will unknowingly dismantle the largest conspiracy of her era.

title: Mortal Online 2
description: Mortal Online 2 is the long awaited sequel to Star Vault’s long running first person sandbox MMORPG. Explore a massive open sandbox world and choose your own path, but be aware, danger lurks around every corner in this full PvP full loot world.

title: Rage Among the Stars
description: Do you have what it takes to get back home? Rage Among The Stars is a rage inducing, fast paced platformer, featuring 40 levels, a ghost mode in order to race yourself and beat the levels at your best time! It also features an easy mode for those who want a more casual experience.

title: Total War: Three Kingdoms - Mandate of Heaven
description:
The Total War: Three Kingdoms – Mandate of Heaven Chapter Pack depicts the events of the Yellow Turban Rebellion, enabling players to engage in the conflict from either rebel or loyalist perspectives.
Introducing a number of new characters and playable faction leaders, the campaign begins in 182CE, but players can choose to continue well into the Three Kingdoms period, with familiar characters entering the campaign as the timeline progresses.

title: A.D. Cop
description: A.D Cop is a rail-shooter game, a clone of Virtua Cop. The game is all about fast aiming and features six missions, although only three are available at the beginning. Each mission is divided into three stages with a level boss at the end. The player (policeman) uses a special helmet equipped with a viewfinder computer. The computer marks the opponent in a frame defining the threat level and time remaining to attack. The player is equipped with a gun and bazooka. During the mission, he can raise the weapon of the killed opponent, f.e. shotgun, grenade, M-16, automated pistol. Killing a hostage takes one life. Life can be supplemented by finding a heart symbol.

title: Skullgirls Encore: Robo-Fortune
description: Robo-Fortune is the last of five additional characters funded by Lab Zero’s Indiegogo campaign to be added to Skullgirls Encore. Robo-Fortune comes equipped with all manner of advanced weaponry, including lasers, chainsaws, and mouse missiles.

title: Skullgirls Encore: Eliza
description: Eliza is a diva with a secret - a dark and ancient past. Host to the skeletal parasite, Sekhmet, Eliza manipulates her own blood to ruthlessly crush her foes. She is the third of 5 additional characters funded by Lab Zero’s Indiegogo campaign to be added to Skullgirls Encore.

title: Skullgirls Encore: Squigly
description: Add the zombie opera singer, Squigly, to your fighting roster! Squigly has a unique and powerful play-style, featuring spacial-manipulation and stance-cancels.

title: Skullgirls Encore: Big Band
description: Big Band is the second of 5 additional characters to be added to Skullgirls Encore. Once a cop known as Ben Birdland, he fell flat when he got on the wrong side of New Meridian's corrupt police force. Birdland was broken and bent out of shape by his former colleagues, but was tuned up by Dr. Avian and ASG Lab 8. Now he is armed with a full ensemble of pneumatic weaponry, making him the full fortissimo instrument of justice: "Big Band."

title: BlueBoi
description: Jump and run through 8 levels in this simple 2D platformer starring BlueBoi!

title: Duck Hunt
description: A faithful tribute that captures every little detail of the original game developed by Nintendo in 1984. Test your reflexes in this PICO-8 demake of the NES classic!

title: Telltale Batman Shadows Edition
description:
Step into the shadows and experience the twisted world of Telltale's Batman in a way that brings the fractured persona of the Dark Knight and the City of Gotham to life in a sinister, new way. Enhanced with hand recolored game play and remastered textures, the Telltale Batman Shadows Edition brings all ten Telltale Batman episodes across two seasons into one, complete game while staying true to the spirit of the Dark Knight's rich, visually compelling history.

Includes:
• Batman: The Telltale Series (Episodes 1-5)
• Batman: The Enemy Within (Episodes 1-5)
• Batman Shadows Mode

title: Batman: The Telltale Series - Shadows Mode
description: The Batman Shadows: The Enemy Within mode brings a captivating new look to the storied Telltale Batman games. Enhanced with hand recolored gameplay and remastered textures, replay your favorite Telltale Batman episodes and experience the twisted world of the Dark Knight in a sinister, new way.

title: Creature Keeper
description: Creature Keeper is a top-down action-adventure RPG where you can befriend wild creatures and raise them to fight alongside you! Scout the creatures of the world and build up your dream team! Cook foods to strengthen your creatures and craft trinkets from the materials grown in your pocket garden. Learn skills from your strongest to help you take on bigger creatures.

title: Pagan: Technopolis
description: An Entirely Pleasant Nightmare

title: Pagan: Emporium
description: The Devil is Watching

title: Dark Dreams RHN
description: Dark Dreams RHN is a Survival Horror Metroidvania based on actual nightmares.

title: Innocent Witches
description:
A time has come to look at a familiar story from a new angle!

Innocent witches is a free, humorous rendition of the story of the boy who lived. A bit brighter, more lustrous, and a whole lot more lustful.

title: Summer Pockets Reflection Blue
description: Summer Pockets Reflection Blue is a new version of the game Summer Pockets with new routes, scenes and a new heroine called Shiki Kamiyama.

title: Nasty Rogue
description: Nasty Rogue is a voxel-based action RPG focused on combat and dungeon exploration. It takes place in an underground environnements overgrown by nature and enemies. The goal consist of getting the best equipement (armor and weapons) to defeat the madest bosses.

title: Malediction
description: Malediction is a third-person puzzle/platformer that gives the player the ability to control space and time! Use your magic to solve puzzles, navigate through a cursed city, and fight magic clones to reclaim your powers.

title: Suspicious Slide
description: Suspicious Slide takes the "ice slide" puzzle to the next level.

title: Frontline: The Great Patriotic War
description: A tactical scale strategy game that invites the players to take command of the URSS forces in an epic struggle for the control of Russia during World War Two.

title: Nightfall Hacker
description: Nightfall Hacker is a strategy game in which you fight to gain control of nodes from out of control enemies.

title: Renegade Grounds: Episode 2
description: Agela, Ingus, and a new ally, a lizardman Rhask, try to clear their names and take on the sinister General Danyll, as well as more dangers, more cultists, and more Ogoz. A continuation of a short, light-hearted story with turn-based combat.

title: Koo & Yuu
description: Koo & Yuu is a minimalist game. Solve the puzzles and take Koo and Yuu to the teleportation bases.

title: Earth Analog
description: In this space flight simulator you take control of the space vessel Eurisko XI in its quest through deep space. Its goal: find our new home.

title: Potion Party
description: Potion Party is a funny couch co-op alchemy game for one to four players. Working as a team, you and your friends must manage your own alchemy shop. Earn money, upgrade your tools, decorate the shop and become a master alchemist!

title: Fight High
description: If you enjoy absolute chaos, blasting enemies to pieces and being surrounded by an overwhelming amount of enemies then this game is for you! How far can you go?

title: Habitking RPG
description: Habitking RPG is a no-frills traditional RPG that rewards you for living a healthy lifestyle. Gain EXP by engaging in positive daily habits. Battle crazy monsters. Defeat the Dragon and become the next Habitking.

title: Mystic Pillars
description: Mystic Pillars is an original blend of intriguing puzzles and an immersive storyline set in Ancient India, providing you with a unique gameplay experience.

title: Fungi
description: Fungi is a strategic online multiplayer game. Grow from a single cell into a multicellular fungus by leeching mass from other players. With the right strategy even smaller fungi can be a threat, so watch out! Play classic Free For All or hold your own in the exciting Battle Royale.

title: Wide Ocean Big Jacket
description: An aunt and uncle take their middle-school niece and her boyfriend on an overnight camping trip. Roast hot dogs on the fire, go birdwatching, tell ghost stories, grab a beverage from the cooler and do cartwheels on the beach. Wide Ocean Big Jacket is a short story game including 20 chapters, four playable characters, 10,000 words of dialog and 8 explorable areas, all rendered in a beautiful 2D/3D art style.

title: Braverz
description: Braverz is a co-op third person MOBA game that incorporates elements of tower defense and base building. Choose from a variety of champions, each with its unique play style and skills. Upgrade your base structures, weapons and skills while pushing back the invaders…are you Brave enough?

title: Slippery Sausage
description: Slippery Sausage is a frantic arcade game where a sentient sausage is out to stop inanimate objects inhabited by mischievous alien spirits! Master handling your sausage, and defeat a wide variety of enemies across 50 levels!

title: Try Again
description: You're Benny, a test character trapped in an unfinished game by a figure called The Designer. She's up against a deadline for her publisher which means it's your last day as a test character. Navigate the facility, dodge game-dev chaos and defy expectations to become the main character.

title: Rehabbers
description: Buy, renovate, design and stage homes to flip for profit or build your own neighborhoods from scratch!

title: Terra Alia
description: Welcome to Terra Alia, an alternate Earth where magic has developed alongside technology. Prepare to solve a mystery and practice a new language in this top-down RPG!

title: Pooplers
description: Pooplers is a multiplayer game where up to four players take control over babies. Toddlers do not belong to the calm ones, as soon as nobody watches them, they crawl around the house, pooping. A humorous game, however, has a number of elements that diversify the gameplay.

title: Nuclear Arms Race
description: Nuclear Arms Race is a revolutionary turn-based game that allows you to produce resources, spy on and sabotage your opponent in order to acquire the nuclear weapon before they can eradicate you.

title: The Winter's Deal: Frosty Edition
description: Dive into a winter, snowy and freezing adventure, fight against demonic powers, explore, pick up gifts with items, find rare items, complete quests and solve the mystery behind these new, bizarre monsters that wreck havoc on Snowbelle Island!

title: League of Pixels
description: League of Pixels is a fast paced pixel art approach on the MOBA genre, with an average game length of 5-10 minutes.

title: How to Build a Magnificent Kingdom
description: The once prosperous kingdom of Avon now lies in tatters with nothing left in its coffers and a pitiful four citizens to its name. Yet even at its darkest hour, Princess Ariadne is still determined to restore it back to its former glory. Will her perseverance carry her through?

title: Eagletalon vs. Horde of the Flies
description: The Eagle Talon is Super hard! Freakin' hard! And now in Puzzle Action form! You become the fighting leader of Eagle Talon, collecting artifacts and friends, and prevent Horde of the Flies' aspirations of world dominance! This game will require you to use your head!

title: Sorcerer Lord
description: The Shadowlord, the evil sorcerer who rules the Northern Shadowlands, has invaded the ancient lands of Galanor. In this fantasy wargame simulation, you must gather the free forces of Galanor and stem the advancing might of the Shadowland.

title: Ground War
description: The Ground-War is a 3D-RTS Game use special to the artillery unit.

title: Hellseed
description: Hellseed is a first person horror adventure with puzzles and some action elements.

title: TaskForce Gamma-13 : An SCP Tale
description: This game is a third person shooter where you, a member of the Gamma-13 task force should recover a lost android, but found much more than expected.

title: DungeonTop: Spell Sword Cards
description: A rogue-like deck-building experience coupled with table top battles. Choose a hero and allegiance then dive deep into the dungeon, evolving your deck for survival. Each choice you make matters, even in between battles!

title: Trials of Guinevere
description: Trials of Guinevere combines strategic, turn-based combat with the emotional, character-focused storyline of a visual novel. In this high fantasy adventure, the heroes must band together to save their home, and their loved ones.

title: The Last Haven
description:
After getting himself into a bunch of messes, gambling, betrayals, bad choices, Tom decides to flee into the woods and start his life over from scratch. But he didn't expect nature to have a surprise in store for him: bringing back all his “nightmares”, people with whom he still has scores to settle.

Use your Master of Gambits skills to collect resources in Brazilian biomes and defend yourself from the shadows that want to drive you away.

title: Planet Bounce
description: Planet Bounce is an action packed arcade-style space game. Navigate solar systems, fire unique weapons, unlock powerful new ships in your quest to conquer the galaxy.

title: Vault of the Void
description: A CCG roguelite experience. Use your sideboard to swap in and out cards as you progress, perfecting the ultimate combos. Upgrade & customize your cards with Void Stones, infusing them with new abilities to help defeat the insidious minions that stand between you and The Void.

title: Rose Riddle 2: Werewolf Shadow
description: A menacing presence has claimed its first victim on the streets of the Fairy Kingdom! More will follow unless you solve the mystery of the Werewolf Shadow!

title: Rum & Gun
description: Journey across the Indian Ocean, uncover the secrets of the Drunken God, and become a legendary pirate captain. Rum & Gun mixes fast-paced shooter action with light ARPG elements. You're not on the Caribbean anymore...

title: William and the Lands of Rage
description: A boy named William gets turned into a robot, and his soul is stolen from him by The Tempter. In order to retrieve his soul and become a boy once again, William must battle his way across five worlds, facing gruelling challenges and evil bosses along the way.

title: Strike!OvulationDivine Fist! Rebellion to Extinction!
description: Easy Operation Battle Fuck Action! ! This game is an action game While defending against the attacks of the Extinction Shrine Maiden using the shield activated by the S button, approach and restrain the enemy by pressing the Y key. Mash the Y key quickly to raise the Libido gauge. Fill 6 gauges to clear the stage.

title: Vectorlord
description: In Vectorlord you play as the titular hero as you dodge & weave through the kaleidoscopic immune system of the evil INFECTOPHAGE --- an intergalactic virus siphoning precious DELTAs from the homeworld of your benefactors.

title: British Gangsters
description: Dive into the timeless England of the 60's and set off in pursuit of the dreaded Doctor Wong! Shooting, intrigue, fantasy in a breathtaking comics world!

title: Dungeon Cards
description:
Dungeon Cards is an exciting mix of puzzle, card game, and a classical roguelike. Each movement of your card creates a unique and challenging situation, a mini-puzzle which requires strategic thinking to solve.

In this card roguelike, you move your character card about a field of nine cards. You have to clash your card with neighboring cards to move it. Monster cards and trap cards will decrease your card's health, healing cards will... well, heal you, cards with gold will increase your game score and there are also many other cards with unique abilities and behaviors.

title: lil' Sherman
description: lil' Sherman is a 3rd person action tower defense RPG that takes place in a stylized WW2/Alt-Universe.

title: Woodle Tree 2: Deluxe
description: A new edition of Woodle Tree 2 is here, with many enhancements! Will you be able to save Mother Nature in this vast open-world Adventure? This time a devastating menace is taking over the Wood Lands with a black substance that is absorbing life and energy from all living creatures!

title: Legend of Streets
description: Show them who is the ruler of the streets by cleaning up gangs, pirates, mafia and cops and other enemies on the streets!

title: X-Team
description: X-TEAM is a role-playing strategy with a non-linear narrative. You must form your squad and fight aliens around the world. Use dozens of weapons, paranormal abilities of heroes and your charisma to destroy the enemy!

title: Harem Hotel
description: Harem Hotel is an Adult Visual Novel with Dating Sim and Training themes… Develop relationships, skills, and your hotel, with 18 beautiful and fleshed out characters. Featuring fully animated and completely uncensored lewd scenes, an array of stats and traits to build and unlock, many outfits to use, unique characters and fetishes, over 560 unique events, over 14,000 images, and way, way more to come.

title: Town of Passion
description:
Town of Passion is an adventure styled RPG, where you play as a common villager living in the small town of Valencia; a town full of many secrets and populated only by beautiful women. After stumbling into an unknown realm, the villager learns that there's an important role for him to fulfill: utilize Pleasure to save those that watch over Valencia!

Solve tricky puzzles! Help out around Valencia and build relationships with the Villagers! And go out and explore the exciting world filled with lustful Monster Girls!

title: Zombie's Retreat
description: Zombie's Retreat is an action RPG involving a young man and his camping retreat. What's intended to be a bonding experience turns horribly wrong when a sudden evil outbreak spreads across the camp. With very 'strange' circumstances surrounding this new found threat, it is up to the player to save any and all survivors while attempting to escape in one piece!

title: Gamer Life
description: meet jerry and on his adventure to become an epic gamer. go and use waldows. go to the gamer store to play demos from paralue

title: Light Fairytale: Episode 2
description: A turn-based JRPG series with a classic feel but modern visuals. Episode 2 resumes the adventure with Haru right after Episode 1's cliffhanger!

title: The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Activity Centre
description: Have fun learning and playing as you explore the world of Batman and Robin. Click a button to enter The Batcave, Wayne Manor, or the streets of Gotham City where you'll find engaging activities, exciting games and mind-bending puzzles. Based in the hit TV series from Warner Bros. Animation, The Adventures of Batman and Robin Activity Center is a challenging and educational adventure for kids.

title: 102 Dalmatians: Activity Centre
description:
Disney Activity Center: Disney's 102 Dalmatians is a game for children aged four and up based on the 2000 movie 102 Dalmatians. Set in London and Paris players can do different types of activities selected from a city map. Many parts of the map can be clicked to receive information about famous sightseeing locations and historical buildings.

London has the Chow Time mini-game where hungry pups need to be fed as an arcade game. A character needs to be moved near the top of the screen, sliding food down one of the four long vertical tables when a puppy appears. The food needs to reach the puppy before they reach the kitchen or a live is lost. The game keeps track of high scores. In the art gallery, a custom picture can be created using backgrounds, stickers, colours, characters and illustrations. You can also adopt a puppy and play with it through actions such as feeding or taking it to the park to meet other dogs and play fetch. There are four international parks to visit including Tokyo.

In Paris, there is a detective mini-game involving locating missing puppies. It can be played with one or two players. This is done by gathering clues from the Parisian Twilight Bark gang of dogs. The answers they provide a stored in a notebook and the player needs to compare these with the description provided about the missing dogs to identify the correct one. Elements include the breed and origin, colour, size, and types of hair and ears. In Le Pelt's bakery, a platform game can be played controlling Oddball. He needs to collect all puppies before Cruella, Alonzo, or Le Pelt capture her. The villains can be slowed down by throwing frosting, butter and jelly at them, collected as power-ups.

title: Aladdin Pinball
description: Aladdin Pinball is a high-speed game set in the magical land of Agrabah. Players join their favorite characters from the film, Aladdin and Princess Jasmine, for pinball fun on three exciting boards. Players can experience the excitement of the city marketplace as they knock down scimitars or hit pots and watermelons. They can also enter the Cave of Wonders and aim for the magic lamp to unlock the multi-ball feature for bonus points, or move into the Royal Palace to knock down Jafar and save Princess Jasmine.

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier - Raven Strike
description: The second downloadable content for Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Future Soldier, Raven Strike is a throwback to traditional Ghost Recon gameplay. It features larger maps, complex missions and an increased level of difficulty. There are three campaign missions, and a new Guerrilla mode map, each playable with up to four players.

title: Lust Epidemic
description:
A student of East State University named Brad finds himself stranded at rival college Saint Dame University during a hurricane that has unexpectedly changed course and struck the town.

While exploring the ancient and creepy campus grounds you'll uncover many mysteries and secrets... as well as some sexy fun time with some amazing MILFS!

title: Treasure of Nadia
description: Treasure of Nadia is an erotic adventure game featuring 12 gorgeous women that you will meet as you adventure throughout the hidden caves and jungles searching for artifacts to make a name for yourself in the treasure hunting world.

title: Bionicle: The Legend of Mata Nui
description:
Lego Bionicle: The Legend of Mata Nui is a canceled action-adventure video game developed by Saffire Corporation.

The Legend of Mata Nui has a three-dimensional, third-person perspective and a similar gameplay style to The Legend of Zelda games Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask, with the player collecting items that enable them to progress further in the game's open environments. Players are tasked with rescuing villagers and defeating Makuta's Rahi and elemental monsters. Each Toa possesses unique abilities based on the element that they control, and additional abilities can be gained by finding the powerful Kanohi masks scattered throughout the island.

title: Oath
description: Fe:Fates Xander/Laslow Tribute Game

title: InFlux Redux
description: InFlux Redux is a high-definition remaster of the 2013 puzzler InFlux, built on a brand new engine with improved graphics, physics and game code. Roll through a series of beautiful environments filled with elaborate, mind-bending puzzle structures.

title: Kronorite
description: Build during the building time so you can stay alive and fight during the combat time. Make killstreaks to get powerups to make EVEN MORE KILLSTREAKS FOR EVEN MORE POWERUPS!!! Kill as much as you can while staying alive for as long as you can to advance as much as possible.

title: Rocky Planet
description: Rocky Planet is an open world sandbox space survival game offering a unique blend of sandbox, strategy gameplay, action, AI, dynamically changing environments, the infinite procedurally generated world.

title: Demon's Sword
description: Demon's Sword is a simple and completely unfair dungeon crawler in the vein of Telengard. Your goal is to collect a number of relics in order to defeat the demon Fulad-zereh, including the legendary Shamshir. You may cast spells or summon powerful demon lords for assistance, but at a dire cost to your Purity. Lose too much Purity and you shall join the damned wandering those accursed halls forever...

title: Unity-Chan Live Stage! -Candy Rock Star-
description: Let's sing the new song "UNITE IN THE SKY" with Kohaku Otori as unity-chan! She is dancing at the live stage of the farewell festival with the fantastic costume called "Candy Rock Star."

title: Fuzzy's Quest
description: Its Fuzzy’s birthday today and wishes is to become a wizard. During his visit to the wizard’s palace, the evil Koodies invade the party his family were preparing. When Fuzzy returns, he finds his family have been kidnapped and his party ruined. He sets off on a mission. Will he find his family?

title: Detective Masochist -The Case of the Femdom Torture-
description:
The story so far: Our pathetic, lazy hero and his childhood friend Satomi, as beautiful as she is brilliant. He lives his days in a hardboiled fantasy, playing at being a detective while barely managing to make ends meet. She's attending a top university and looking after him by acting as his reluctant partner.

Never quite managing to make it past "just friends", the two get wrapped up in a startling incident, and suddenly things are turned upside down! Due to the actions of a mysterious man, Satomi is transformed into a super sadist whose thirst for punishment cannot be quenched!

The sadistic Satomi toys with our hero, twisting him this way and that...perhaps finally going so far as to force him to claim her virginity!

"If I don't change Satomi back to normal quickly...I'll never be able to resist her punishment..."

What fate awaits our hero? Will he be able to track down the mysterious man and save Satomi? And what will become of the two of them?!

title: Detective Masochist 2 -The Case of the Tortured Servant-
Survival Camp
description: The story takes place on Halloween night, when people are wearing masks to revel, the mysterious virus spreads quietly, and the virus engulfed the world instantly. The world is no longer safe. You need to build a camp and survive. Good luck. . .

title: Grimalkin: Solar Defense Force
description: Command a Rag Tag fleet of Grimalkin Vessels against the evil from Beyond. Lead your Grimalkins to Victory or Suffer Ultimate Defeat and lose earth to the greatest evil known to Grimalkin-kind the Evil Ancient Space Faring Empire.

title: Kakatte Koi Yo!
description: A platform fighter where cats battle using fish. Kakatte Koi Yo! has multiple win objectives and a large selection of maps. Use fish to explode, electrocute, and spear your opponents to victory.

title: Bad Girl
description: Bad Girl - Hardcore platformer made in the old-school style where there is nothing superfluous

title: Live checkpoint
description: The game is a 2D platformer with a side view of the game. The main task of the game is to protect the checkpoint from bloodthirsty zombies and prevent them from breaking...

title: Journey to New Atlantis
description: Journey to New Atlantis is a post-apocalyptic adventure game that follows Lana and her friend Marco in their quest to find water for Lana’s ill grandfather, in a world almost completely dried up. Lana’s grandfather tells them of an oasis city called New Atlantis, and the two children will need to brave sandstorms, roving bands of...

title: Neomorph
description: This is a simple tower defend like game,click mouse left button to shoot enemies, make sure you don't get hurt. Defeat Neomorph, fight with ladies!

title: Slay the Bigies
description: Slay The Bigies is an anime style hack'n slash action rpg game with randomized loot and inventory system.

title: Nordic Storm Solitaire
description: Help northman Elof lead his people to a land promised by the God Feyr! Beware… this land is under dispute by the Jotun Idyl, an archrival of the ancient Gods. Play through 130 challenging solitaire levels and chase away the Jotun Idyl!

title: Boom Boomerang
description: Boom Boomerang is a virtual reality arcade-style boomerang game. Master the skill of throwing and catching virtual boomerangs to destroy bombs before they explode. Unlock new boomerangs by collecting awards in Arcade Mode, test your limits in Survival Mode, and fend off the assault in Onslaught Mode.

title: Everyone Dies
description: [Great time killer game] People have never been so close to extinction, and all because of one mistake of nature. A dove a symbol of peace, love, purity, hope? Not in 2027.

title: For the Warp
description: A roguelike deckbuilding game in space! Explore randomly generated systems, enemies and strange encounters. Build your deck, survive and reach For The Warp gate!

title: Colossals
description: Colossals tells the story of a vagrant, who, together with his love interest, the soon-to-be-Empress Khalida, interpret the fairy tales they read in front of a windmill to be fact, telling them of a faraway land where, once upon a time, giants roamed.

title: Mystic Hammer
description: Mystic Hammer is a genre mashup of a lane defender strategy game with an Action RPG. Unlock powerful abilities and new characters while following a compelling story throughout multiple environments.

title: Santa's Christmas Solitaire 2
description: An old foe has returned to ruin Christmas this year, can you help Santa defeat him and recover the Christmas presents?

title: Midjungard
description: A Tolkienesque Multiplayer Game set in the primeval world of a pre-Viking Midjungard. PvP and PvE multiplayer modes. Exquisite level design and beautiful lighting. Thrilling combat.

title: Mouse Mayhem Shooting & Racing
description: Help the cute little mouse 'SUEAKY' as he race, shooting and destroying enemies and overcomes hurdles with nothing to lose!

title: History Racers 2
description: This is a very funny 2D racer game that mixes karting and running gameplay, with historical characters across the world!

title: Mini Island: Night
description: Mini Island: Night is a one small hold & Gun, boss Rush mini-game of Casual difficulty.

title: Bounce Knight
description: Delve into the lair of the Peckomancer and overcome his gauntlet of traps, trials, tricks and army of the undead. All the while trying to rescue your beloved pet dog.

title: An Odyssey: Echoes of War
description: Fight the sea god's wrath to reclaim your throne, and free yourself from the ghosts of war. Will you live forever as a hero, a sovereign, or as a god?

title: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon
description: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon is an open-world RPG set in a dark fantasy and reimagining the Arthurian legend.

title: Delusion
description: Delusion is an unusual puzzle game that tells a story about a beautiful world, full of life and colors, which changed beyond recognition after a series of unexplainable events had taken place.

title: Typhoon Unit: Butterfly Requiem
description: Squad up! Switch heroes on the fly, and chase down the Steel Butterfly in a world where magic and technology intertwine! Are you the right team for the job?

title: Food Girls: Civil War
description: A popularity voting bet based on your dignity! Win or leave the Street Market!The second major game in the cuisine personification simulation series. A popularity war that we fight without holding anything back!

title: Colormeleons
description: A painting chameleon without any talent - and a talent without money. Help your chameleon-artist to satisfy his need for recognition in this ultimate Idle-Painting-game where everything is about being part of a great community to reach your goals together with other players and get valuable rewards.

title: Wrest
description: Wrest is a sci-fi horror VR game. You play Andy Bishop, an engineer who wakes to discover a terrifying mystery unfolding in his home. Enter the mystery @WrestVR and stay tuned for updates.

title: Impossible Soaring
description: Soar through the sky at intense speed while gracefully dodging perilously close obstacles. Test your reflexes and precision maneuvering ability as you master the challenging but intuitive skill of flight. Greater risk means greater reward!

title: HoloSprint
description: HoloSprint is a gesture controlled racing game. This means you do not need your keyboard or controller to drive your car. Just stretch your hands out in front of you and start steering.

title: My Name is You and it's the only unusual thing in my life
description: This is a novel with multiple plot lines, in which you only get to witness only a couple of days of a character who’s name is You. It may seem that except for his name, his life is nothing exceptional. That is if it wasn’t for a chain of events that fluctuate between his daily routine and an existential terror of reiteration. What is the most important part? It’s you and You facing inevitability.

title: Void Breach
description: Twin-stick space combat roguelite with 12 abilities, 5 reality-warping ultimates, and 20+ enemy factions that each fight differently. Permanent upgrades that stack across hundreds of hours. Quick missions, deep progression, zero runs wasted.

title: Medieval Frontiers
description: First-person colony simulation where strategy meets survival in a demanding, medieval wilderness. Construct gridless settlements, establish production chains, and manage the needs, desires, and work morale of your villagers to ensure their survival through the harsh realities of nature and disease.

title: Primitive Hunter
description: In „Primitive Hunter” game you are moving to the old times and become a trapper who deals with hunting by using ancient technics of creating weapon and hunting tools like: spear, stone or arc and learning how to trucking animals by searching their traces.

title: Lumin's Path
description: Lumin's Path is an atmospheric 3D platformer using light and darkness to impact the world in mysterious ways.

title: Cirno's Perfect Summer Vacation
description: This game was made for the ⑨ Jam, a special Cirno Touhou game jam!

title: My Friend is a Raven
description: You return to your old apartment one last time, in search of a sickened raven. You must speak to him, and discover the cause behind the calamity that has spread across the world.

title: Grayland
description: Grayland is a story‑driven side‑scroller where you play a tiny bird caught in a war‑scarred, radioactive world. Fly and fight through 16 handcrafted levels, avoid drones, solve environmental puzzles, and face varied bosses as you work to eliminate radiation hotspots and rescue your loved ones, all set to a distinctive noir art style and atmospheric soundtrack.

title: Gizmos: Steampunk Nonograms
description: Solve challenging nonograms (also known as picross, griddlers, etc.) to decipher a message from a distant planet!

title: Model Railway Easily Christmas
description: Model railway builder wit true 3D graphics. Place all the highly detailed objects on the snowy landscape and create exciting model railway layouts! Start your trains and enjoy the Christmas style decorated environment!

title: Flagfights
description: Flagfights is an online action shooter in which you can choose where you want to fight and the side to play for. The goal of the game is to capture the flag as long as possible against the other team and at the same time shoot as many opponents as possible.

title: Super Crystal Hunter
description: Enter this Arcade-RPG adventure incarnating the young thief Slade. Go through multiple places to loot in the Eastern Lands, visit special zones, face several bosses and discover various mini-games and additional extras.

title: Ultimate Zombie Defense
description: Team up or face it alone in this top down zombie slaying defense adventure! Featuring up to 4 player online co-op, cleanse the infected wave by wave and upgrade your base with traps & defenses to build the Ultimate Zombie Defense. Can YOU stop them?

title: Infferno
description: Infferno is a post apocalyptic isometric top down shooter for 1-2 Coop Players Online or Local Offline

title: The Pirate Queen
description: Welcome to THE PIRATE QUEEN! Slash your way to survival!

title: Robot Island
description: Play as a robot flight attendant named Nim! Unfortunately, people aren't taking space vacations these days, so it's just you and the captain. The two of you talk about normal stuff, and sometimes he asks you to get him coffee or clean... which is what you were built for!

title: Basic Warfare
description: Basic Warfare is a combination of RTS and Action genres featuring realtime multiplayer action combat and strategic economic simulation.

title: Suzunaan on Fire
description: Suzunaan on Fire is the first Touhou doujin game produced by Creator Team from SakuraGaming. Players will roleplay Kosuzu Motoori and figure out the way to escape from fire. If you like puzzle games and also like Touhou, welcome to play our first game.

title: Breakneck City
description: Old school 3D Beat-Em-Up Action! Use your wits, reflexes and environment to take on the ruthless gangs of Breakneck City!

title: Dead Motherland: Zombie Co-op
description: A co-op top down shooter about zombie apocalypse in Russia. Explore russian locations - cities, villages, industrial zones. Enjoy the dark, realistic atmosphere. Shoot from a russian weapons. Run from hords of fast bloodthirsty zombies! Play alone or in a co-op for 4!

title: Naval Armada
description: The world of Warships sends a challenge to you! Play with friends against the enemies and win epic battles on torpedo boat destroyers, cruisers and battleships! Build your own game strategy and leave opponents no chance!

title: Gericonia 2
description: You are the leader of a new Settlement. Sent from the Capital, your goal is to tame the lands and uncover secrets. In this strategy game, you will build a city and manage different resources. Expand your town, battle outsiders, master the unknown and launch expeditions.

title: Arida II: Rise of the Brave
description: Journey through the 19th-century Brazilian backlands in this narrative, culturally rich adventure. Face the drought to explore arid biomes, craft and manage resources, complete quests, and guide Cícera to Canudos - the mythical village promising to change the story forever.

title: Kanna
description: Join us in a magical new world! Decide what role you will play in the massive living, breathing world of...

title: Prens Cavid
description: It was many years ago... Suddenly, dark clouds descend to the Persian empire that live in wealth, justice and peace. Evil forces that invade the land of the country destroy all dynasty members by entering inside the castle. Except for someone..

title: Coloniam
description: Colonize islands and grow your population. Manage trade routes and resources to meet the ever increasing needs of your colonist.

title: Yuletide Legends: Who Framed Santa Claus
description: Take on the role of an experienced detective and get carried away by a winter adventure amid frozen lands. Find hidden motives of the antagonist and save Santa Claus from a false conviction in this seasonal Hidden Objects adventure.

title: Lake
description: It's 1986 - Meredith Weiss takes a break from her career in the big city to deliver mail in her hometown. How will she experience two weeks in beautiful Providence Oaks, with its iconic lake and quirky community? And what will she do next? It's up to you.

title: Magin: The Rat Project Stories
description: Magin is a combination of a narrative-driven adventure RPG with a deck-building card game. The nonlinear plot, comic book esthetics, full voiceover and game mechanics are all tightly attached to the represented world in a unique fantasy setting.

title: Juken Jigoku
description: Juken Jigoku is a Japanese themed horror game inspired by the fears, anxiety and doubts that students have to go through during their school life and the exams time.

title: Britannic
description: Welcome aboard the HMHS Britannic, the sister ship to the RMS Titanic. Experience first-hand how the biggest ship in the world met its demise in 1916. Do you have what it takes to survive?

title: Bunny Park
description: Manage your own bunny park! Give snacks and toys to your bunnies. Improve and decorate your park to increase its popularity and collect all the bunnies!

title: Gala Collider
description: Four billion years in the future, Earth is a distant memory devoured by the same sun that once gave it life. The Milky Way and Andromeda galaxies are in the middle of a cosmic collision triggering a battle for dominance and survival between alien species.

title: Mr. Fast
description: Mr. Fast is a top-down shooting game with a bullet time twist! Enemy's time moves more slowly than yours. You're fast enough and you can kill others with one shot.

title: Guardians of the Ashes
description: As a rookie female soldier being lost memory. Your are tasked with investigating a group of criminals in the deserted city of Orland and unknowingly discovering a secret ruins underground. And here, you being attacked and chased by demons, things drag on after things ... the true origin of the world gradually reveal... and then, as "The Chosen One" - you have to protect the world.

title: Heroes of Maidan 3
description: “We face a difficult combat task - to cleanse our land from Russians” Take part in the liberation of the occupied territories of the Crimean peninsula

title: FLS
description: FLS is a Scifi Sandbox Racing game.

title: The GoD Unit
description: The GoD Unit is a first-person physics-based puzzle game set in a near pre-apocalyptic future, featuring the mass manipulation ability and other familiar and beloved puzzle mechanics.

title: Jane Westlake Adventures - The Mystery Train
description: Follow Jane Westlake on her quest to discover the secret of a mysterious train and stop it from leaving with its cargo.

title: Guiding Light
description: Guiding Light is a co-op game in which you and a friend need to rescue stranded aliens from all kinds of sticky situations. One player is an alien who goes down to the planet to execute the rescue operation, while the other pilots the UFO to help guide the alien on the ground.

title: Escalation: Aggressors
description: Escalation: Aggressors is a real-time side scrolling strategy game set in the hypothetical 1980s world war scenario, realistically incorporating hundreds of sea, air and land units clashing in uncompromising battles between the two biggest superpowers in human history.

title: Rat Racer
description: Rat Racer is a physics-based car simulation where everything is calculated in real time by Nvidia PhysX engine. All tracks are "virtual sandboxes" where you can drive everywhere and do anything what your car physics allows.

title: Summer Games Heroes
description: Practice a multitude of sports, such as athletics, horse riding, cycling, swimming and more.

title: Wrecker
description: Wrecker is an 2D arcade game set in space. In it you will fight off an endless horde of aliens in waves using your special issue high powered missile turret.

title: Fifo's Night
description: Fifo's Night is a 3D puzzle-platform videogame that takes place around an enchanted mansion. A gameplay with different combat skills and a lot of jumps, makes Fifo's Night an entertaining game for all audiences.

title: Samurai: Ronin's Path
description: First samurai simulator on Steam. In Samurai Simulator game you play the role of a samurai who is growing up in a Japanese village and practicing in samurai art. You collect honor points and it depends on it if you stay alive or die in a battle.

title: Undead zombies
description: This is a third person action game，The player is surrounded by zombies，Players are free to explore the surrounding area or enter the building to see what's going on，Players must maintain health, avoid zombie attacks or kill zombies.

title: Flying Shot
description: Flying Shot is a voxel first-person shooter that involves dismembering opponents, physical blood, realistic destruction of glass and walls, and slow-motion parkour.

title: Granny: Chapter Two
description: You have to escape Granny and Grandpa...You have five days...

title: Zom Nom
description:
Zom Nom is a humorous, 2.5D, side scrolling platformer with puzzle elements for PC. 
 
Play as Barry, a brain munching, gob spitting, slap happy Zombie. Spit and Slap your way through the streets and sewers to take on the President of the World. Claim your place as Ruler of all Human and Zombie-kind.

title: Inertial Drift
description: An arcade racer that tears up the rule book with innovative twin-stick controls, completely re-imagined driving mechanics and a huge roster of fiercely individual cars and tracks.

title: Cut Smash Wrap
description: Destroy blocks using the combinations of the famous Rock, Paper, Scissors game! Smash scissors blocks using rock blocks, cut paper with scissor and wrap the rocks! Match 3 or 5 blocks to multiply your score!

title: Find Me: Horror Game
