description: What happens when a group of friends decides to visit a mysterious, haunted castle? What started as a bit of fun is about to become a life-changing event for them. But the real question is: can they make it out of the castle alive?

title: Gjana's World
description: Hard action-platformer that tests patience.

title: Data Dream
description: In this 3D platformer, a bio-digital landscape filled with walking, talking computer components finds itself in a state of peril following a malicious invasion. An unlikely hero must brave this surreal world in order to rectify and restore the jeopardized system.

title: Birth to Death
description: Embark on the wonderful adventure that is life. Form meaningful connections with the people around you. Be comforted by material wealth. Experience a vast array of achievements… Unless you screw it up and die before doing anything.

title: The Dark Side
description: What if the world is completely different from what you are used to seeing it? What if there are a lot of secrets in it which are protected by Guardians at all times?

title: Network E.L.E.
description: Network E.L.E.™ is an open-world, survival story set on Planet Mercury in 2184, an abandoned city — military base filled with deadly radiation. You play as Myorah, a NASA exploration pilot going after four Mercury-980 single board Space-VPX chips, which activate a dormant spaceship left within the city.

title: Dark Tunnels
description: You own a small website where you publish paranormal horror videos. You go to a asylum that was abandoned 20 years ago and record for a few minutes but you realize your locked in. You only option is to escape before realizing your not alone.

title: Ninja Turdle
description:
Ninja Turdle sets out to destroy all the parasites in order to save his creator, Steve. 
 
Ninja Turdle is a 2D Metroidvania platformer that involves exploring all through Steve's body destroying parasites. 
 
# Story 
Get ready to fling corn infused turds at everything that moves as you help Ninja Turdle make his way through Steve's parasite infected body. But hurry up before Steve is completely consumed by flesh eating parasites. 
 
# Game Play 
- Explore over 175 inter-connected chambers ranging from Steve's stomach, intestines, heart, lungs, toilet, and even deep into his brain. 
- Find masks and power-ups that offer new abilities such as the blood mask, wall climb, anti-acid pills, dung beetle, and many more. 
- Toss chunks of turds at parasites. 
- Infuse your turds with Corn to launch even more powerful attacks. 
- Explore deep enough and maybe even learn the secret art of "Shoryupoo" and "Hadoupoo". 
- Three different difficulty modes. 
- Different techno tracks for each area. 
- 45 Steam achievements.

title: CityWarHeroes VR
description: In 2050, alien spaceships suddenly approach peaceful earth. The spacecraft lands in Incheon, South Korea, making the area a shambles. You'll have to fight against aliens as armed special forces, armed with armor and weapons packed with the most advanced technologies of the future. But what if the aliens are cute?

title: Thunder Kid II: Null Mission
description: Thunder Kid is Back! Battle robots in this Old-School Low-Poly 3D Run'n'Gun Action Game!

title: Kika & Daigo: A Curious Tale
description: Kika & Daigo: A Curious Tale is a local splitscreen co-op game where you go on an adventure to find your lost grandpa. Use your unique abilities to work together to solve the mystery of grandpa's disappearance. Can you find back grandpa?

title: Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Online
description: Beyond Enemy Lines 2 Online is a free-to-play military first-person-shooter focused around tactical gameplay and weapon modifications. Players can quickly modifiy their weapons on the fly and master their skill in a wide range of game maps, modes and weapons on Dedicatded Servers. Entirely for free!

title: Magnet Fishing Simulator
description: Are you bored of traditional fishing? Put your rod away and search in outdoor waters for ferromagnetic objects available to pull with a strong neodymium magnet. Find rare and valuable items, restore them, and sell!

title: Green: An Orc's Life
description: A Reigns-like card-swiper. Grow an orc. Pilot it through a life of pillage, plunder and gluttony. Build up your horde, become filthy-rich with loot, even become a god! Planned for release- early 2020 for Steam and mobile.

title: Free Agency
description: Life simulation game but you gotta keep them too busy to become self-aware.

title: A Moustache in the House
description: You are not alone in your own house.... solve the puzzles and find a way out.

title: Virus L
description: The World has changed. Zombies infest every corner of it. Its time to turn back the tide of undead. Earn upgrades and new weapons in this thrilling adventure.

title: Hasfax
description: Unfamiliar place and memory loss. What would you do if you were in that position? Find out the true reason for your appearance here or just run away. Remember, looks are deceiving ...

title: Reach Coin
description: Sometimes I'm hungry, I put a coin in that kind of machine but the candy just won't get out. What happens with my coin in there?

title: Angry food
description: Angry food is a logic game for creating chains of identical elements. The goal of the game is to put in a row from 3 identical elements, get points and go to the next level There are also bonuses. Not all bonuses are useful. Some may do harm.

title: Ludus
description: Build the best ludus in the world! and survive in ancient Rome.

title: WizardPunk
description: WizardPunk is a precise 3D-Fighter with random fighter generation and permadeath, focused on customization. Adventure mode provides an RPG-like experience, with stat growth and guild specialization. Versus mode provides a more classic fighting experience.

title: I have lived
description: Welcome to the end of an unnamed world. Its last wishes have materialized as two entities. Become a part of their journey and give the world another chance by recollecting the world's remaining Essences.

title: Frostford
description: Defeat monsters and grab the control in Frostford!

title: Ramiwo
description:
Ramiwo is unusual, arty walking simulator with orientation puzzle elements. 
Discover a vast variety of environments. 
Can you find them all?

title: Get the Banana
description: Play as a trapped monkey who must solve puzzles to reach food. Learn the rules behind the puzzles as well as the motivations behind the experiments. Get the Banana is inspired by classic Sokoban puzzle games.

title: The Puzzle Box Society
description: Welcome to The Puzzle Box Society. Break in, bypass their security systems, find the secret areas, steal the valuables, and get out.

title: The Blackbird of Amor
description: When there is an unsolved mystery, Stein can't let it go, he must pursue it till the end. In Amor there is a certain woman that interests him, she is rumored to have eternal youth. To solve the mystery of this woman he must tear heaven from earth. His journey will take him far beyond the world he has known.

title: Terminal squad: Swarmites
description: Terminal squad: swarmites is a game with indirect control where you must erect a chain of buildings, which generate resources for construction or the combat units for destruction of an enemy.

title: Gorilla Town
description: Science! A 1920s Art Deco world chock full of giant gorillas, spiteful robots, and highly combustible blimps. Battle friends in turn-based combat or play alone and help Victor the gorilla escape 22 levels of robotic revolt! Inspired by the classic artillery game, Qbasic Gorillas.

title: Melody Flight
description: Melody Flight is a serene and soaring rhythm game. Fly through classical piano music as a spirit in search of musical energy.

title: Gun Miner
description: Gun Miner is a rogue-lite where you explore the ever-changing caves of a mysterious planet. Dig up treasure with your void-blaster rifle. Spend any loot you find on upgrades for your suit, for your gun, or for your ship. Yes you will die a lot, but each turn makes you a tiny bit more powerful.

title: The Forgotten
description: The Forgotten is a first-person psychological horror game. Discover a beautiful yet eerie environment with secret locations that will keep you on the edge of your seat with fear. Find your friends if they are still alive and uncover the dark secrets of the forgotten valley before they are gone forever.

title: The Mechanical World of Dr. Gearbox
description: Unravel the forgotten mysteries of an elderly adventurer by retracing his steps across four distinct environments. Overcome the odds by recruiting a deep roster of eccentric and fascinating creatures to aid you on your quest to discover the truth.

title: Tower of God: One Wish
description: Tower of God is a match-3 game with fun mechanics and enjoyable Game play. The levels are varied and fun. The game also includes mini-games such as Hidden Object, Jigsaw, Memory and Slider.

title: Escape from the death castle
description:
You don't know why you are locked in this castle, but you know you should escape here. 
 
Enemies are everywhere, and they will never let you through. Their only purpose is to prevent you from leaving. All you can do is find for food and weapons in each room, improve your attribute ability, defeat them one by one, and leave here.

title: Ghost in the Barn House
description: Ghost In The Barn House is a 2D Survival Horror game based on the story of an old Haunted barn which was built in the 1800s in Texas.

title: Furious Drivers
description: Dynamic “car combat” game, where you destroy other players by cars using a variety of weapons.

title: Fist of the Forgotten
description: Jump, punch, and slide through the remnants of civilizations using forgotten artifacts to augment your movement and combat abilities on a journey to find the last human holdouts where your brother might be.

title: Ruinic
description: Ruinic is a massive multiplayer adventure, with monsters to kill, quests to complete, and treasure to win. You control your own character who will improve and become more powerful the more you play. This isn't a game where everything that happens is pre-determined. What you do in the world is up to you!

title: CaveBugBoy
description: CaveBugBoy embarks on an epic adventure through dark and mysterious underground caves in search of a better life. The journey will encounter evil floating and screaming skulls, flying dead ants and flies, falling lava rocks, and collect bugs body parts.

title: Westminster Darkly
description: A turn-based strategy RPG set in modern time Westminster (UK), after a massive solar storm causes the end of the electric age.

title: Carpet Bombing
description: Carpet Bombing is a retro-style, 2D aircraft arcade game. Fly a jet fighter and engage enemy at land, sea and air! Choose from different aircrafts - each with their own unique flying profile. Arm yourself to the teeth and get ready for some serious action!

title: Nocturnous
description: Fight your way through hostile lands as you search for the soul of a once powerful king and destroy it.

title: Defense and Revenge
description: Defense and Revenge is a turn-based strategy set in fantasy universe. You have to lead orcs tribe, provide defense and take revenge on enemies invading your land.

title: Hotel Renovator
description: Build the hotel of your dreams! You’ll welcome guests from all over the world. Use your starting cash to rebuild and furnish as many rooms as possible. Create a place that smacks the golden age, a new exclusive hotel. Get that 5-star review!

title: Cold War Minister
description: Become the leader of the USSR consumed by the vision of establishing a world-class superpower. Wage the Cold War brutally and without compromise, or through cunning politics and effective propaganda.

title: Terramancer
description: Terramancer is a strategy game combining card combos and worker placement. Send your golems collect resources and be the first to complete your Tower. Use card combos to adapt your island to the seasons. Play with friends or take on solo challenges.

title: Caveman the Game
description: Even in Prehistoric times love existed. Play as the Caveman and help him rescue the love of his life who has been taken by a gang of rebel cavemen. Lead the Caveman through 20 levels of jumping over tarpits, climbing vines and fighting dinosaurs to free his love from the clutches of the rebel caveman gang!

title: Voidspace
description: A highly experimental SCIFI sandbox MMORPG. Using only 2D, top-down visuals, we're attempting to push the limits of the MMO genre to create a game world that is similar in some ways to Ready Player One. Featuring perma-death, and player societies. Every man-made object is crafted by a real player.

title: Unexpected Sequence
description: Unexpected Sequence is a game inspired by classic bullet hell titles, aiming to keep the original feel and some of the difficulty. Customize your ship and fight your way back to humanity through hordes of enemies and unique bosses.

title: The Walking Evil
description: The Walking Evil takes you to the great classic of the horror of the survival of the 90s, controlling the main character with a fixed camera system that enhances the feeling that you are incredible in a real horror movie.

title: The Artefacts lost in the Galaxy
description: You must find information about the stations infected by the extraterrestrials. You can kill the enemy, but also destroy annoying objects, push them, or use them to pass an obstacle. To succeed in your mission, you own a percussion gun and a fusion rifle.

title: Return to Shironagasu Island
description: A mystery-adventure game set in the solitary Shironagasu Island. In this game you become detective Sen Ikeda and explore the secrets of Shironagasu Island with your assistant Neneko Izumozaki.

title: Marco & The Galaxy Dragon
description: Marco, an orphan with missing memories, and Arco, a dragon who rules the galaxy, were hunting for treasure in space! On one of their adventures, Marco was given a clue to the whereabouts of her mother. Their next stop, her birthplace - Earth!

title: Flirt Balls
description: Flirt Ball

title: The Fairytale of Death
description:
The Fairytale of Death is a text adventure that should never have been written.
A story that is told to you like from a fairy tale book. A fairy tale that can only be finished through wise decisions.

title: Go For a Walk
description: Go For a Walk through a world made of music with your canine companion!

title: To The Sea : The Courier
description: After the world was forcibly cut into blocks by aliens and sold, human society has created a unique profession of courier, spanning space and fear, and delivering important information and materials.

title: Sanguine Soul
description: Experience Malieun's quest for vengeance in this first-person action adventure exploration game! Having barely survived an assassination attempt by the wandering wizard Noor, Malieun discovers a newfound power that enables him to exchange his magical energy and life force.

title: Zooma
description: Immerse in the universe of a magic mind-teaser in VR. Do you have what it takes to make your way through all the riddles and save the world in time? Check out what happens if you mix shooting, puzzles and classic match-three in virtual reality.

title: The Ghost Tower
description: The Ghost Tower is a futuristic dungeon crawler with survival horror elements where you fight your way to the top floor of a mysterious tower while piloting your own Robotic Combat Suit.

title: A Percent of a Pirate
description: A captivating pirate adventure to learn math while having fun. Available in some schools, this game will teach you different ways to manipulate percentages and ratios.

title: Is the President a Traitor?
description: Race against the clock to stop the President and their conspirators from destroying the integrity of American institutions. Starting with only meager funds and dogged perseverance, you will conduct an intelligence investigation of the President’s circle of aides, advisors, and donors.

title: The Island Story
description: The Island Story is leisure simulation game. Players can change the appearance of the island by placing different animals, plants and decorative items freely. Plants and animals also produce fruit and dust resources for further exploration and play.

title: DragonRide VR
description: Dragon Ride VR is an interactive fantasy dragon experience designed to immerse you into the magical world of land, sea and air. Choose from a variety of smooth, fast and wild rides or opt in for some fun shooting games to capture the highest score!

title: Pawnshop Tycoon
description: Start with a garage full of old junk and expand to a thriving business. Manage sales and train staff to automate redundant tasks. Relocate or expand your shop with many options across the city. Learn all the ins and outs of becoming a big city Pawnshop Tycoon!

title: Max Gentlemen Sexy Business!
description: Victorian Business Tycoon? Dating Sim? Why not both!? Become England’s largest Monopoly. Romp and cavort with 12 other sexy executives, just like a real tycoon!

title: Explorers of the Abyss
description: After Princess Olivia's father falls ill, it's now up to her to explore the labyrinth known as "the Abyss" and seek a way to restore order to the kingdom.

title: Emu War!
description: Human vs Emu carnage! Play as either man or bird in this game featuring open world, sandbox environments to smaller scale arena skirmishes. Customize your own battles using unlocked characters, weapons and vehicles in Architect Mode!

title: Space Elite Force II
description: Space Elite Force II is a classic side scrolling gaming experience with many enemies, explosions and upgrades for your ship. Have fun defeating bosses, upgrading your ship and blowing up enemies, alone or with a friend in local co-op mode.

title: Juicy Army
description: Juicy army is a cute action roguelike set in a colorful universe where you'll have to fight an army of juicy creatures!

title: Pentasma
description: Pentasma is a side-scrolling arcade shooter inspired by Williams Electronics' 1981 classic 'Defender'. Protect The terraforming Humanoids from the deadly Aliens and raid the Alien planets to keep the galaxy peaceful!

title: Bunker 56
description: In the game, you need to properly distribute food and drink, as well as monitor the daily routine. While you'll be looking for and get to the exit of the bunker.

title: Haxity
description: Haxity is a cyberpunk, roguelite, action deck-builder. Draft your deck, modify your fighter and outsmart your opponent. Fight online, challenge your friends or terminate the AI. Slot, hack and execute, welcome to Haxity!

title: Destinata
description: Made by a young kid... Destinata is the platformer game... which does not look like what it actually is. In the end... it's a game that improves as you play.

title: Gifted
description: (Technical Prototype) Gifted is a 3rd person, single-player and couch-co-op, role-playing, social/economic simulation and village-building game.

title: Chuusotsu! 1.5th Graduation: The Moving Castle
description: Join Arue and her merry Chuusotsu band on her first visit to a certain doujin event in the Big Site, and share in her struggles as an aspiring manga creator!

title: Femida
description: Judge Simulator 2020. Play the role of Judge Daemon Mardoch and investigate the disappearance of your father during the Last Revolution. Set in the dystopian State with a post-WWII level of tech and noir aesthetics.

title: Amakano
description: Censored Port of "Amakano".

title: Wargroove: Double Trouble
description:
Team up and lead the Outlaw faction to strategic victory, with new criminal Commanders in the new free DLC, Wargroove: Double Trouble!

Wargroove: Double Trouble adds a brand new co-op enabled campaign story which introduces Outlaw Commanders; the mighty Wulfar, troublemaker twins Errol and Orla, as well as the maleficent Vesper.

title: Rover Mechanic Simulator
description: As an Engineer - crew member of one of the first Mars colonies - you are responsible for repairing and maintaining Mars Rovers. In this advanced simulator you will learn the internal details of various Mars Rovers and their components.

title: Half-Life: Anti-Climax
description: Half-Life: Anti-Climax is my take on the "battle you have no chance of winning" the G-Man offers you once you decline his job offer at the end of the Half-Life campaign. Is there truly no chance to win or can you lead Gordon to victory and freedom?

title: HellScape: Two Brothers
description: Hellscape: Two Brothers is an Athmospheric, 3D, Adventure, Puzzle game.A journey through Hell inspired by Dante Alighieri's Divine Comedy.Two brothers take on a quest to find and save their loved one kidnapped by the devils servants.

title: War Trigger 2
description: Destroy, smash and blast your way to victory. Use advanced weapons and vehicles to dominate the battlefield.

title: Tune the Tone
description: Tune the Tone is a rhythm game. Reach to light speed with your fingers at challenging levels. Show your skills and make everyone see your name on online leaderboard. Feel the bass and feel the great atmosphere. Master your beats.

title: Love Me Forever
description: Love Me Forever is a Puzzle, Exploration RPG with dark humor and profanity. You slip into the role of a young firefighter, that saves the life of an excessive, clingy girl. Following up in a cute, insane relationship together that will last forever... according to her.

title: Dusk Warlocks
description: Ever wished to fight using large scale spells? Dusk Warlocks is an online multiplayer spellcasting game in which up to 4 players compete in a tactical battle.

title: Into the Flames
description: An Open World multiplayer firefighting game!

title: Paperball
description: It's time to get rolling! Navigate tricky passages, pull off crazy stunts and get ready to fall off a lot! Play carefully or risk it all for the fastest time - play any way you want in over 150 all unique stages.

title: Millions of Minions
description: Sorcery. Creepy Crawlies. Unknown Critters. Dungeon Delving. What more could you ask for? Oh.. Bosses? WE HAVE THOSE TOO!

title: Night of The Living Dead VR
description: NOTD VR is an exploratory experience that captures the original spirit of the film in black and white, immersing users in a 3D recreation of the film’s farmhouse set. Exclusive interviews with film experts and original cast and crew enrich the experience with insights into the horror classic.

title: RhythmDanceVR
description: RhythmDanceVR is a rhythm game where you have to try to hit as many beat fields as possible. Filled with a large selection of songs, it turns your surroundings into a dance club.

title: Border of Insanity Origins
description: Do you know what insanity is? The illusory perception of reality and the repetition of the same actions. Immerse yourself in a world where nothing can be considered real. Where you are alive and dead at the same time and surrounded by the walking dead. Feel what real madness is.

title: Code Lyoko: Carthage Explorer
description: Code Lyoko: Carthage Explorer (or simply Carthage Explorer) is (or rather, will be) an "Open World" type game, strategy, management, combat, construction and finally an exploration game of an almost infinite universe.

title: Uncle Sad Bedroom
description: Go to work or get an internship with anarcho-syndicalists. Go to other galaxies and dimensions. Fly a living ship around. Fight mother nature's aunt. Slide down an apocalyptic spa. Snort moon rocks with your landlord. Ride the train. Get evicted. Talk about nothing in particular. Play an operating system instrument.

title: OpenApoc
description: OpenApoc is a remake of the XCOM: Apocalypse engine, with an eye on making it easier to extend/modify, much like OpenXCOM did for UFO:Enemy Unknown

title: OpenXcom
description: Open-source clone of the original UFO: Enemy Unknown / X-Com: UFO Defense by Microprose.

title: Inglorious Pirate
description: Inglorious pirate is a 2D platformer with side-view shooter elements. The player will play the role of an old pirate, from whom a treasure treasure was stolen.

title: Immanence
description:
Immanence is a psychological thriller, the spiritual successor to the one of the previous games by Cat In A Jar Games called Nyctophilia. This is an author's project, developed by one person.

The game keeps the main features of the original, such as atmosphere, visual style and approach to the soundtrack, while raising the bar for quality. More attention is paid to the gameplay and variety of situations.

Immanence is a small free adventure, full walkthrough takes approximately 1-2 hours.

title: Next Hand Master
description: Welcome to NextHandMaster! Here we will test your real skills in managing several objects with just one hand, and do not think out any extra thoughts about the name, here you will have pain, cry, as well as millions and billions of suffering, see who becomes the real NextHandMaster!

title: The Lost Brewery
description:
You will be called upon to help the Gnome Miners carve out their tunnels, fight against the Gremlin Pests who insidiously sabotage the Gnomes' sophisticated machinery, stave off death in clashes with your rival, resolve the in-house problems of an enchanting Elven innkeeper, find your way out of a web of intrigue woven by crafty sorcerers and succubi, and much, much more.
Atmospheric graphics, old school combat, elaborate dialogue, and nuanced characters will ensure your full immersion in this truly unforgettable, fantastic adventure.

title: Trusty Brothers
description: "Trust me, brother" is a local 2-player co-op game. Grab your friend, start the adventure, find the great sun treasures around the world! If you fail, it must be that you don't trust each other enough!

title: Tanks 2020
description:
A computer game for two players in the arcade genre.
The player must, controlling his tank, destroy another player.
The action takes place in four arenas.
The score goes up to five points, one victory - one point.
Whoever wins the first five rounds wins.

title: MyBot
description: MyBot is a single and multiplayer 3D Puzzle game with a surprise, a user friendly level editor which allows you the freedom to create your own levels.

title: Ghone is gone
description: Under guard 24/7 by his enemies, ex-Nisson Motors CEO Loscar Gon tries to escape a country, using various tools. Once a titan of the car industry and a CEO of the cartel of Ruso, Nisson, and Bishibishi corporations Loscar Gon is under a country’s heavy 24/7 monitoring.

title: The Dreams of Candlelight
description: This is a suspense plot decryption game during the Republic of China, telling the protagonist in order to find the mysterious past that happened sixteen years ago...

title: Chip: Rescuer of Kittens
description: Metroidvania in retro-style about a space rescuer of kittens. Travel from planet to planet, shoot to evil robots and save stolen kittens!

title: Retro Drift
description: "Retro Drift" is a small arcade drift game that can be played with one hand. The game advocates fast-paced play, a 10-second start, and a ten-minute game. It is suitable for a game anytime, anywhere.

title: Floating World Before the World This Life
description: "Floating world before the world this life" is an independent stand-alone game, this game is floating world myriad game series in the second.The game is a full-length xiuxian novel stream game, using the traditional turn-based combat system.

title: Human Delusion
description: Human Delusion is a short but impactful story about a transformation from being restrained inside the human experience to being free and present. Human Delusion is an exploration of one’s emotions, consciousness, mind and their perception of reality. Are you ready to choose true Freedom?

title: Adrift Arena
description: Adrift Arena is an arcade 3D platformer where you have to overcome various platforming challenges in a lava filled arena.

title: Rakan Ayah
description: 大学生女主父母失踪了好几年了，她要同时照顾自己和赚钱养家，生活十分的穷困潦倒，有天她偶然遇到了一份招聘启事，酬劳十分高，让她无法拒绝，按招聘启事所说的她找到了男主角的独居，并被成功录取为女仆......

title: Some Some Convenience Store
description: A game about starting a relationship while working part-time at a convenience store.

title: The Ambassador: Fractured Timelines
description: The Ambassador: Fractured Timelines is a twin-stick fantasy shooter centered around the ability to stop time.

title: BallsBlasterVR
description: Try your shooting skills in arcade mode. Destroy the balls by creating combinations. Get the best score !!

title: Crazy Simulator
description: Oh my god, this is Crazy Danila's simulator! Herman, this is just an incredibly funny! Superable Atmosphere, Fashionable Clothing Store, Great Locations and Cool Design!

title: Wonder Cat
description: BossFights, Run & Gun, Runner, non-linear walkthrough, airplanes, bathyscaphes and magic creatures.

title: Model Kit Simulator VR
description:
Model Kit Simulator VR is a casual simulation where players can assemble and paint simple model kits in VR:

- Great for people looking for leisure VR experience
- Easy to get into; great for showing off VR to your friends
- Has multiple model kits to choose from

title: Triumph Action

Two Love
description: Text adventure An English noble could no longer tolerate the torture of disease.Just when he decided to end his life,he met a traveler with black hair and red pupil...An English vampire is still looking for what she wants.On Canvey Island,she sees a glimmer of possibility...A talented woman chasing her enemies,a message came...

Help Hugh to fit in and learn what human life is like by manually moving his head, arms and legs as you work together to explore an array of fun and wacky jobs in the pursuit of helping Hugh to fit and be accepted by all!

description: Mayhem Masters is a fast-paced arena blaster where the key to victory is skill and tactical thinking. Collect the best powerups for yourself, and obliterate your opponents with explosions, blocks, or diseases. Choose one of 10 colourful, archetypal characters and master the Mayhem!

title: New Planets
description: Save your teacher and yourself on a journey based on a new solar system!

title: Recluses
description: More than 30 orthodox sectarians underground. They locked themselves in man-made caves. You're a negotiator. Your task is to rescue recluses before Apocalypse.

title: Creepy Tale
description: Find out the dark story that befell the once-calm and peaceful forest, turning it into a creepy place filled with evil. Perhaps it is you who will be able to solve all the secrets of forest and save the peaceful creatures?

title: Guardian of Lore
description: A mystical library houses books of ancient folktales from lost civilizations. Play as prince Sayri, and protect these stories from wicked magic that aims to erase their memory forever. Enter each story and save it from within... or at least part of it.

title: Jef
description: Travel the galaxy, find a dog, watch billionaires put together Ikea furniture for regular people, learn about the Sourcefield, get mentally healthy.

title: Gravity Escape
description: Gravity Escape is a pixel platform puzzle game. Hero K got the gravity gun by accident and has the ability to control gravity. He need to break through dangerous traps and enemies to find a way back to the from the unknown planet.

title: Legend creatures
description: roguelike+自动战斗的独立游戏，你可以收集各种奇幻生物，组成团队，这些生物还可以进化到不同的分支。

title: Spooky Spins: Remastered - Steam Edition
description: Spooky Spins Remastered is a 5 reel, 25 payline slot machine (pokie) with a Spooky theme.

title: Operation Deep Magic: Cryptanalysis
description: Reconnaissance operatives infiltrated a corporate building and extracted electronics and files encrypted with 56-bit DES. Items were handed over to you, the cryptanalyst. Your mission is to decrypt the files.

title: Reborn Not Again
description: Black and white are always just a moment. With the rise of the Dark Side, everything in the tower would be polluted and betrayed. You have to start a new with the help of the goddess Talia. Whether will you get rid of samsara and recast the balance between black and white? Maybe it is just a reincarnation.

title: Spacer Project
description: " You are sent into space aboard your spaceship to eradicate any alien threat trying to invade the galaxy.... Facing waves of enemies drawing their strength from the genesis of video games, and armed with rudimentary weapons or slaloming in an asteroid field! Face the growing difficulty of Spacer Project.

title: Touhou Fantasy Day
description: 这是一款东方+传统RPG游戏。 幻想乡的太阳突然不会落下，永日威胁着整个幻想乡的安全, 于此同时，各地的小妖精们也蠢蠢欲动，一切都在预示着幻想乡又要发生一次巨大的异变......

title: Fallen Hearts
description:
This is a multiplayer RTS/RPG game from the first person in a fictional medieval world. Take control of one of the castles and become the sole king of all lands 
 
You, as a true king, only give orders, in this game you do not need to take special care of micromanagement, but the key decisions in the economy and war depend only on you. You can personally explore the world in search of artifacts that will help you defeat your enemies or go into battle with your army.

title: Rugby League Team Manager 3
description: The third instalment of “The Number 1 Rugby League Management Game”. The biggest leagues and competitions. Take full control of managing your own Rugby League club. Training schedules, coaches, physios, scouting, finances, sponsors and more. MUCH MORE!

title: Little Tennis
description:
Little Tennis is the most simple, yet addictive tennis game you'll have ever played! 
 
Simplifying the game of tennis to its core principals, use the mouse, the keyboard or a gamepad to control your player. Time your serves and perfect your returns to win games. Winning games allows you to earn gems in order to unlock new skins, colours, rackets, flags and clothing to customise your player.

title: Science Show VR: The Abyss
description: A five-sense, deep-sea scientific exploration VR content that travels through the five oceans in search of marine topography and secrets of reproduction.

title: Idle Space
description: Your cursor won't linger in Idle Space as you play this exciting and fast-paced clicker. You will work to defeat an encroaching fleet, with every explosion collect metal to create, produce and upgrade factories to keep you in the fight.

title: Project RTD : Random Tower Defense
description: Project RTD is a Random Tower Defense PVP Game. Players will compete against each other, defending with randomly built towers or attacking other players by summoning monsters to become the “Final Winner”. The thrill of randomness and Strategic Tech Tree. Experience both in one game!

title: Mommy
description: Meteor storm falls on Sweet Country. All country inhabitants disappear. Help little Toby survive, find his Mommy, safe locals and restore his home!

title: Path of Redemption
description:
“Path of Redemption” is a dark fantasy role play game, a tribute to the great titles like Dark Souls series, Sekiro, Onimusya. 
You need to fight your own way to survive the deadly enviroments. 
The using of counter attack system is very important to conquer the strong enemies. 
If you are a fan to this type of game, please give a try!

title: Brass Town Wrestling
description: Brass Town Wrestling takes the small open world RPG approach of Harvest Moon, mixes it with the stat building system of Princess Maker 2, and throws you into the crazy world of professional wrestling! Will you become a champ or another jabroni?

title: The Gladhollow Nasties
description: A beast stalks the forest by night. It will take cunning, stealth, and strategy to survive long enough to untangle a nonlinear mystery through one wooded village and many despicable generations. Play through the eyes of the sinful, pernicious, malicious morsels themselves: The Gladhollow Nasties.

title: Enloyea: Chapter of the Origin of Alchemy
description: Creating a horizontal version to explore RPG

title: Sea of Leaves
description: A young girl escapes from her hometown, leaving friends and family. After many years, she returns to her place. Why does she come back? What was behind her escape? Leaves is a contemplative game where the environment plays a key role to explore main character's thoughts, memories and sensations.

title: Shaolin vs. Wutang 2
description: The sequel to Shaolin vs Wutang! Shaolin vs Wutang 2 is a INDIE love letter to Martial Arts and classic Kung Fu films. Made for casual game fans not intended for Hardcore Fighting Game players.

title: Pussy Puzzle
description: 20 beautiful hand drawn kitties from JujiBla put together in a relaxing puzzle experience.

title: Sliding Puzzle Collection
description: Sliding Puzzle Collection is a traditional sliding puzzle game with a relaxing atmosphere.

title: Cogret
description: A futuristic horror survival game that includes different modes such as Zombie mode, Multiplayer mode and of course an epic Campaign mode!

title: Parked in the Dark
description: Find you car somewhere in the garage by finding clues, before the time runs out. But you are not as alone as you think...

title: Shardhunters
description: A tactical, turn-based skirmish game where two players fight intense battles for control over powerful gemstones. Shardhunters puts your team building and tactical senses to the test while offering multiple win conditions.

title: The Manse on Soracca
description: Tasked with finding a lost woman by the name of Bridgette Camilia, private investigator Herbert Castaigne sails to the mysterious, fabled island of Soracca where he finds an imposing mansion. What he finds inside will change his life forever... as it will change yours.

title: DonDon Busters!!
description: DonDon Busters!! is a local multiplayer game that brings you head to head with up to three other players in a chaotic and fun free-for-all! Last one to remain standing on land is the winner; so blast everyone that isn't you out of bounds, and get ready to DonDon!!

title: Jimmu
description: Jimmu is a challenging Japanese horror-themed boss hunting game that takes place in Japan centuries ago. The game features a non-linear open-world with some RPG elements.

title: Your Quest 2
description: Gather resources. Build a village and protect your people. Give them jobs to become self sufficient, and arm them to survive the attacks of hungry predators. Explore what lurks beneath the surface, and hope you have prepared well enough to survive it. This is your quest.

title: Run Dude
description: Hardcore, bloody platformer with a simple dude.

title: The Supper
description: The Supper is a short adventure game about the darkest side of the human soul. Ms. Appleton was always a wellspring of kindness, until The Voice started talking to her.

title: Emily Archer and the Curse of Tutankhamun
description: Lady Archer is invited to Egypt to see the priceless treasure of King Tutankhamun by her friend Lord Carnarvon. She arrives to find her dear friend murdered and the mask of Tutankhamun stolen. Collect evidence to solve the murder in this hidden object game!

title: Dead Ground Arcade
description: Dead Ground Arcade is an action packed FPS VR shooter, ready to get your heart skip a beat during exciting standoffs with infected creatures. Players take on the role of a secret agent for Blackrain, for whom they are sent on a range of challenging missions.

title: Funny AntiVirus TD
description: Funny AntiVirus TD is a Tower Defence Game with 10 kinds of Tower and over 50 kinds of Virus ,you need make a plan of build Tower and pass every level

title: Palace of sky
description: 突如其来的变故打破了山村的宁静， 一名不速之客的到来，造成相依为命的爷爷亡故。 为此，一名原本应该平凡的少年，为了替爷爷报仇，踏上了修行之路。 随着对事情的调查深入，他逐渐解除到了传送中的东西——九霄仙阙。

title: Strings
description: Experience fast-paced VR combat without sacrificing comfort. Battle enemies using unique items scattered throughout each level. Move quickly by throwing teleport orbs. Store items in your inventory and equip them instantly. Confront fearsome bosses with challenging fight mechanics.

title: Mask of Mists
description: Mask of Mists is an action-adventure game in a first-person view in which you are immersed in exploring the world full of magic and dangers!

title: Ballistic Craft
description: A bullet hell of your own making! Play the game where strategy and creativity meet -- duel rival wizards in real time battle arenas with custom shot crafting to win the Tournament of Crafters!

title: Zhēnlóng Zhǔzǎi
description: 《真龙主宰》是一款大型多人APRG游戏，游戏中拥有养成、冒险、打斗、社交、互动等各种丰富多样的功能。玩家可以通过点击空白处的方式控制自己的角色，在3D静态地图配合2D动态模型的即时光影成像技术下与怪物战斗，和兄弟结盟，挥洒热血，激战沙场。在服务器架构上支持多服务器动态支撑技术，能容纳数万玩家在游戏内娱乐。游戏美术设计上汲取了东西方的美术元素，使用玄幻而写实的美术风格，人物造型华丽而独特，富有真实立体效果和绚丽的光影。

title: The Final Stand: Breakout
description:
The Final Stand:Breakout is a multiplayer wave based survival game, play as Light Containment Task Force agents during multiple outbreaks of RA-005.
Survive endless waves up to 10 players, of infected populous (RA-005-B), earning money from killing or damaging RA-005-B and completing certain tasks. Money can be used to purchase weapons, open doors, and activate traps. RA-005-B become stronger, faster and appear higher numbers in every following wave.

title: Submersed
description:
Rediscover the meaning of terror with Submersed.
Coast Guard paramedic Jack Ballard, recently reincorporated after the death of his wife, responds to an emergency call from an offshore structure in high seas. The place seems to be abandoned, so who sent the message? Help Jack Ballard find out the truth, exploring the darkest reaches and flooded areas teeming with dangerous predators, solving enigmas and puzzles while you try to survive.

Are you afraid of depths? You will be.

title: Eternal Blood
description: Eternal Blood is a fast-paced shooter that places you in an arena to face legions of demons. Armed with dark magic and a fluid movement system, fight to survive alone or with a friend.

title: Blue Time

title: Dark Gravity
description: Shoot, destroy, collect, craft and destroy even more! "Dark Gravity" is a fast-paced, low poly vertical shoot'em up game that features non-linear campaign mode with lots of enemies and bosses. Craft new weapons, upgrade your fighter and build an ultimate aerial war machine!

title: Pirates Treasure II
description: Pirates Treasure II is a 5 reel, 25 payline slot machine (pokie) with a Pirate theme, oriented from left to right.

description: This is an experimental visual novel with a length of about 30-60 minutes. It tells a story of a female crossing.

description: A cool puzzle on the surface of a 3D cube. Shoot colored bricks on the playing field, making three or more blocks of same color together.

description: "Reality. A term concocted by creatures to give worth to their version of reality...But what is reality if there are so many realities?" What happens if a being of a 2D world is dragged into the virtual world of a 3D realm?

title: North of Iraq Part 1
description: North Of Iraq Part 1 || The pandemic : expands upon the team-based action gameplay that it pioneered . Covid:19 features new maps, characters, weapons, and game modes, and delivers updated versions of the modern content

title: Kingdom Warrior
description: 在一个王国里 你即将成为新国王， 但是你会遇到各种各样的困难。
